note: people the app had left out (owner, 8 November 2026: 'Just do it'); ties for their new files

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: In 1693 Agatha's mother leads the trial of her own daughter for dark magic. Agatha begs her, then turns the coven's spell back and kills them all.
stages.whoA: Her daughter, who kills her at the trial.
stages.whoB: Her mother, who leads the trial against her.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Summoned at the coven's spirit trial, her mother's ghost demands Agatha be punished and takes hold of her until Alice banishes her.
stages.whoA: Her daughter, whom she still wants punished.
stages.whoB: Her mother's ghost, still set against her.

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: When Agatha's mother's ghost takes hold of Agatha at the spirit trial, Alice's magic banishes her.
stages.whoA: The witch who banishes her ghost.
stages.whoB: Agatha's mother's ghost, whom she banishes.

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Strange shows West up by saving a patient West had given up on. After Strange's crash, West pins his crushed hands, and Strange blames him for ruining them. Months later Strange hands him a scalpel to try to save the Ancient One.
stages.whoA: The star surgeon who shows him up, then blames him for his hands.
stages.whoB: The rival surgeon who pins his crushed hands.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: At Christine's wedding West tells Strange he lost his brother and his cats while he was dust, asks if the Snap was the only way, and needles him that he can't have everything.
stages.whoA: The old rival he sits beside at Christine's wedding.
stages.whoB: The old rival who needles him at Christine's wedding.

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Christine doubts West's call of brain death on her patient and brings in Strange, but defends West afterward and keeps him as her neurosurgeon. Later they work side by side to save the Ancient One.
stages.whoA: The ER doctor who doubts his call but defends him to Strange.
stages.whoB: The neurosurgeon she relies on and defends to Strange.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: West is a guest at Christine's wedding, where he needles Strange that he still didn't get her as she comes down the aisle.
stages.whoA: The old colleague whose wedding he attends.
stages.whoB: An old colleague who comes to her wedding.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Dennis waves to Wanda and Vision as they arrive in Westview, one of the townsfolk held in her spell. When the spell lifts, he and the others plead with Wanda to let them go.
stages.whoA: The witch who held him in her spell
stages.whoB: A Westview mailman caught in her spell

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: When Billy and Tommy go looking for their lost dog, Dennis tells them not to worry. He says their mom will not let the dog get far.
stages.whoA: A Westview boy who lost his dog
stages.whoB: The mailman who cheers him up

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: When Tommy and Billy go looking for their lost dog, Dennis tells them not to worry. He says their mom will not let the dog get far.
stages.whoA: A Westview boy who lost his dog
stages.whoB: The mailman who cheers him up

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Agatha begs Death to spare her newborn and names him Nicholas Scratch. The boy lures witches for her to kill, and they sing the Ballad of the Witches' Road together until Death takes him in the woods.
stages.whoA: His mother, who kills witches with his help
stages.whoB: Her son, who died as a boy

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: In the Spirit Witch trial, Nicholas reaches Billy through a Ouija board and spells out his name. Later, Billy tells Agatha her son would forgive her.
stages.whoA: The boy who hears him through a Ouija board
stages.whoB: Agatha's dead son, who speaks to him

stages.title: Agatha All Along
stages.text: Death comes for Agatha's newborn and grants him only time. Years later, Death returns for Nicholas in the woods and tells him to kiss his mother goodbye.
stages.whoA: Death, who comes for him as a boy
stages.whoB: Agatha's son, whom Death takes away

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Henry resents Peggy joining his frozen body case and fights her leads. When she learns he faked the killer's style, she tries to talk him into surrender just before a cop shoots him.
stages.whoA: The SSR agent who exposes his cover up
stages.whoB: The LAPD detective who faked a killing

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Henry insists he can handle the Jane Scott case without the SSR, and Sousa sends him off on his own lead. Later, Sousa reads Meltzer's report and sees Henry faked the killer's style.
stages.whoA: The SSR chief who takes over his case
stages.whoB: The LAPD detective who faked a killing

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Henry sneers at Wilkes as a janitor. Then, sick and freezing everything he touches, he grabs Wilkes at gunpoint and demands a cure.
stages.whoA: The scientist he takes hostage
stages.whoB: The sick detective who takes him hostage

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Henry pushes Meltzer for a quick report that backs his Lady of the Lake theory. Later, he touches the examiner and finds him frozen solid as he shatters.
stages.whoA: The examiner on his case
stages.whoB: The detective pushing him for a report

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: As Henry flees the coroner's office with Wilkes, he breaks Jarvis's nose and takes his car.
stages.whoA: The man whose car he steals
stages.whoB: The detective who breaks his nose

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Peggy and Jarvis bring a disarmed Nitramene bomb to Dr. Vanko at Stark Industries. He tells her it still gives off vita radiation and that only Roxxon could build it.
stages.whoA: The SSR agent he helps with Nitramene
stages.whoB: The Stark scientist who points her to Roxxon

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Jarvis comes with Peggy to see Dr. Vanko at Stark Industries. Vanko studies the Nitramene they bring and names Roxxon as the likely maker.
stages.whoA: Howard Stark's butler
stages.whoB: The Stark scientist who studies the Nitramene

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Anton lies dying in Russia as Ivan sits beside him and Tony Stark appears on the news. He tells Ivan that should have been him, and that all he can leave him is his knowledge.
stages.whoA: His son, who vows revenge on the Starks
stages.whoB: His father, once Howard Stark's partner

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Blackwell works for Masters inside the SSR, beating Sousa for him and passing on a call from a woman who knows his code. Masters then sends him to kill whoever fired the cannon.
stages.whoA: The boss who gives him his dirty jobs
stages.whoB: One of his men inside the SSR

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Blackwell and Vega beat Sousa in masks, but Sousa knows him by his Aqua Velva. In the desert, they draw guns on Sousa and lock him in a cell.
stages.whoA: The SSR chief he beats and jails
stages.whoB: Masters' man who beats him in a mask

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Blackwell and Vega catch Samberly with Sousa in the desert. They take his weapon and lock him in a cell at the office.
stages.whoA: The SSR scientist he jails
stages.whoB: Masters' agent who locks him up

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: In the desert, Thompson talks Blackwell and Vega out of Masters' order to kill. They follow his lead and bring Sousa and Samberly back alive.
stages.whoA: The SSR chief whose lead he follows
stages.whoB: An agent he talks out of killing

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Dooley visits Mueller in prison the day before his hanging. He trades a pill Mueller thinks is cyanide for the truth about Finow, then lets him hang.
stages.whoA: The SSR chief who tricks him
stages.whoB: The Nazi colonel who tells him about Finow

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Jones mistakes Peggy for a secretary and asks her name, and she answers, Agent. She then spots Van Ert among his workers.
stages.whoA: The SSR agent he takes for a secretary
stages.whoB: The Roxxon chief who flirts with her

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Peggy sneaks into Jones' office posing as Wanda, and he flirts before he remembers her. She wipes his memory again and again with a device while she searches him.
stages.whoA: The agent who keeps wiping his memory
stages.whoB: The Roxxon chief she keeps fooling

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Thompson and Dooley question Jones about the Roxxon blast. Jones tells them his wife came between him and Stark, and he points them to the Nitramene.
stages.whoA: An SSR agent investigating the blast
stages.whoB: The Roxxon chief with a grudge against Stark

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: At Chadwick's fundraiser, Jones tells Thompson that Peggy stole bomb parts from Roxxon and accuses the SSR of targeting him again.
stages.whoA: The SSR chief he complains to
stages.whoB: The Roxxon chief who reports Peggy

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Jones pours Dooley a morning whiskey and tells him his spies say Stark made a Nitramene formula. He lets the SSR scan his staff for vita rays.
stages.whoA: The SSR chief he points at Stark
stages.whoB: The Roxxon chief who aids his hunt

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: With Gloucester, Jones tells Chadwick the Council is ending his Zero Matter work and that he should focus on the Senate race. Later, Chadwick brings his wife to a Council meeting that turns deadly.
stages.whoA: A Council ally running for the Senate
stages.whoB: A fellow member of the Council

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Whitney kills most of the Council in front of Jones. Terrified, he gives her full access to Roxxon and says he is happy to serve her.
stages.whoA: The woman who takes over his Council
stages.whoB: The Roxxon chief who bows to her

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: At the fundraiser, Jones tells Masters that Whitney Frost now runs the Council. He orders Masters to give her what she wants.
stages.whoA: The Council's man in the government
stages.whoB: The Roxxon chief who passes on Frost's orders

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Zandow ambushes Peggy on the boat full of Stark's weapons and nearly strangles her. She stops him with a Stark device that knots his arm, then knocks him out.
stages.whoA: The woman who beats him on the boat
stages.whoB: The strongman guarding Stark's weapons

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Jarvis joins the fight on the boat, and Zandow pins him and nearly breaks his neck. Peggy saves Jarvis just in time.
stages.whoA: The butler he nearly kills
stages.whoB: The strongman who nearly breaks his neck

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Krzeminski drives the handcuffed Zandow to the SSR and taunts him about Thompson's interrogations. Both are shot dead when their car is stopped on the way.
stages.whoA: The agent driving him to questioning
stages.whoB: The prisoner he drives in

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: After killing Krzeminski at a red light, Dottie shoots Zandow in the back seat. He begs that he would never have talked.
stages.whoA: The assassin who silences him
stages.whoB: The prisoner she executes

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Ken directs Whitney and keeps telling her she looks too old and too wide. After he saves her role from the studio, he grabs her, sees her scar, and she absorbs him in panic.
stages.whoA: The star he directs and belittles
stages.whoB: Her director, whom she absorbs

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Meltzer shows Peggy the switched shoes and the body that glows in the dark. Later, she finds him frozen to death beside it.
stages.whoA: The SSR agent who studies his findings
stages.whoB: The examiner who freezes on the case

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Sousa comes to Meltzer for the Jane Scott autopsy. After Meltzer freezes, Sousa reads his report and learns Henry faked the killer's style.
stages.whoA: The SSR chief waiting on his report
stages.whoB: The examiner whose report breaks the case

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Li covers himself up when Peggy walks into the men's locker room to suit up. In the raid, he fights at her side and calls to her just before he is shot.
stages.whoA: The agent who leads his raid team
stages.whoB: An SSR agent on the Red Room raid

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Li suits up with Thompson for the mission and joins in the locker room joke on Sousa. They fight side by side in the raid until Li is shot.
stages.whoA: A fellow agent on the raid
stages.whoB: A fellow agent killed on the raid

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Li and the others laugh when Thompson sends Sousa to the lockers where Peggy is changing.
stages.whoA: An SSR agent he teases
stages.whoB: An agent who laughs at him

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Li lights up when Dugan steps out of the bushes to meet the team. He then raids the Soviet school with Dugan and Peggy.
stages.whoA: His hero, who joins the raid
stages.whoB: A starstruck SSR agent

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Van Ert brews Nitramene with Brannis at the Roxxon refinery and needles him for never smiling. He flees when Peggy breaks up the meeting.
stages.whoA: His silent partner in bomb making
stages.whoB: The Roxxon man who makes his bombs

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Peggy blinds Van Ert with a flash at the refinery. The next day she gets the SSR to check his locker and trips him when he runs.
stages.whoA: The agent who catches him
stages.whoB: The Roxxon man she catches

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Thompson hands Van Ert a branch to bite and beats him in the interrogation room. Van Ert gives up Brannis and Leviathan.
stages.whoA: The agent who beats him into talking
stages.whoB: The Roxxon man he beats into talking

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Dooley offers to let Van Ert go if he names someone higher up. Van Ert refuses, so Dooley leaves him with Thompson.
stages.whoA: The SSR chief who questions him
stages.whoB: The Roxxon man he questions

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Van Ert works at Roxxon under Jones. When Jones lets the SSR scan his staff, Van Ert runs and is caught.
stages.whoA: The head of his company
stages.whoB: A Roxxon scientist who builds bombs

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Miss Fry interviews Peggy and rents her a room under strict rules. She keeps catching Peggy at odd hours, and is shocked by the hole Peggy cut in her wall.
stages.whoA: Her tenant who keeps odd hours
stages.whoB: The strict owner of her hotel

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Angie sets up Peggy's interview with Miss Fry and later talks her out of a spare key. During the SSR raid, Fry holds Angie while agents question her.
stages.whoA: Her tenant and Peggy's friend
stages.whoB: The landlady she sweet talks

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Thompson snatches Miss Fry's ledger to find Peggy's room and ignores her protests. When she keeps scolding his men, he has two agents carry her away.
stages.whoA: The agent who storms her hotel
stages.whoB: The landlady he has carried out

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Sousa leads the raid on the Griffith with Thompson. Miss Fry refuses to help, and scolds him for upsetting her tenants.
stages.whoA: An agent who raids her hotel
stages.whoB: The landlady who scolds his raid

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Ivchenko shares a Leviathan cell with Nikola and calls himself the scientist's friend and doctor. When Nikola takes a hostage, Ivchenko shoots him.
stages.whoA: The cellmate and doctor who shoots him
stages.whoB: The scientist he calls his friend

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Peggy frees Nikola and Ivchenko from their cell. When Nikola grabs Sawyer to trade, she begs him to stop.
stages.whoA: The agent who frees him
stages.whoB: A prisoner she frees, who turns on her team

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Nikola explains to Thompson how Stark found a way to change the waves of light. He shows him the design he was forced to build.
stages.whoA: The agent he explains Stark's design to
stages.whoB: The scientist who explains Stark's design

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: The Commandos help free Nikola, but in the firefight he holds a gun on Sawyer and offers the Americans to the Soviets.
stages.whoA: The team he turns on
stages.whoB: The prisoner who takes Sawyer hostage

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Sawyer serves under Dugan in the Howling Commandos and grumbles that he hates the name. He fights beside Dugan in the raid on the Soviet school.
stages.whoA: The leader of his Commando unit
stages.whoB: One of his Commandos

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Sawyer and the Commandos join Peggy's mission in Belarus. He fights alongside her as they escape the Soviet school under fire.
stages.whoA: The agent whose raid he joins
stages.whoB: A Commando on her raid

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: In the firefight, Nikola grabs the wounded Sawyer at gunpoint and offers him to the Soviets. Ivchenko shoots Nikola and frees him.
stages.whoA: The prisoner who takes him hostage
stages.whoB: The Commando he takes hostage

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: When Nikola holds Sawyer hostage, Ivchenko shoots his own friend to save him. Sawyer then helps get Ivchenko out with the team.
stages.whoA: The doctor who shoots his captor
stages.whoB: The Commando he saves

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Juniper is hurt when Sawyer says he hates the Howling Commandos name. They head into the raid together.
stages.whoA: A fellow Commando
stages.whoB: A fellow Commando

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: At the campfire, Dugan teases Juniper about crying over a yeti. In the raid, Juniper is killed with Dugan's gun after a girl stabs Dugan.
stages.whoA: His Commando leader, who teases him
stages.whoB: A young Commando he teases

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: After Thompson tells the campfire a story of a killing he regrets, Juniper quietly offers him a drink.
stages.whoA: The agent he comforts by the fire
stages.whoB: The Commando who offers him a drink

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Juniper joins Peggy's team for the raid on the Soviet school. He jokes about the creepy classrooms before a girl shoots him.
stages.whoA: The agent leading his raid team
stages.whoB: A Commando killed on her raid

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Juniper and Li search the school with Peggy and Dugan. Both are shot by the same girl assassin.
stages.whoA: A fellow raider on Peggy's team
stages.whoB: A fellow raider on Peggy's team

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Peggy asks Doobin how his research on Stark's inventions is going while she secretly photographs them. Later, she fetches him to free Dooley from a heat vest, but he cannot.
stages.whoA: An SSR agent who asks about his research
stages.whoB: An SSR lab scientist studying Stark's inventions

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Dooley shuts down the lab after a security breach and brushes off Doobin's offer to vouch for his team. When Dooley is locked in a heat vest, Doobin can find no way to save him.
stages.whoA: The SSR chief who shuts down his lab
stages.whoB: A lab scientist who cannot save him

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Nonna cooks with her grandson Joseph and bickers with him over his gravy. When Sousa threatens him she pulls a knife, and later, as Joseph despairs over Whitney, she tells him to work with Peggy.
stages.whoA: Her grandson, who cooks and confides in her
stages.whoB: His grandmother, who backs him and gives advice

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Nonna warms to Sousa and serves him spaghetti at Joseph's table. When Sousa threatens to set Tommy Fontana on Joseph, she pulls a knife on him until Joseph drags her away.
stages.whoA: The agent she feeds, then pulls a knife on
stages.whoB: Joseph's grandmother, who pulls a knife on him

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Nonna takes against Peggy on sight, spits and gives her no plate, and Joseph jokes that she thinks Peggy is the devil. Later she still tells Joseph to make a deal with Peggy to save Whitney.
stages.whoA: The woman she thinks is the devil
stages.whoB: Joseph's grandmother, who thinks she is the devil

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Mink sneaks into the Griffith to kill Peggy, and Dottie steps out and asks if he is looking for her. When he orders her back to her room, she admires his automatic pistol, breaks his neck, and keeps the gun.
stages.whoA: The neighbor who kills him for his pistol
stages.whoB: A gunman she kills outside Peggy's room

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Peggy helps Jarvis beat off Mink's men when they try to shake him down for Stark's delivery. Mink learns her name, tracks her to the Griffith, and creeps to her door with a gun, but dies before he reaches her.
stages.whoA: The woman he hunts after his shakedown fails
stages.whoB: A smuggler who comes to kill her and Stark

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Stark pays Mink to smuggle him back into the country, calling him greedy but predictable. When his men fail to squeeze Jarvis for more money, Mink decides he wants Stark dead.
stages.whoA: The client he smuggles home, then wants dead
stages.whoB: The greedy smuggler who brought him home

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Ramirez goes to Belarus on Thompson's team, partly because he speaks Russian. He laughs along with Thompson's locker room prank on Sousa, then follows him into the base and out through the firefight.
stages.whoA: The agent who leads his team to Belarus
stages.whoB: A Russian-speaking agent on his Belarus team

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Ramirez is embarrassed when Peggy walks into the men's locker room to gear up. In Belarus she introduces him to the Howling Commandos and sends him to find a back way out of the base.
stages.whoA: The agent who brings him into the Commandos' fight
stages.whoB: A fellow agent on the Belarus mission

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Ramirez is starstruck to meet Dugan, who fought beside Captain America. Dugan's men save the team in the firefight, and Ramirez shakes his hand before flying home.
stages.whoA: The famous Commando he fights beside in Belarus
stages.whoB: An awestruck SSR agent on Peggy's mission

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: When the SSR traces Stark to Russia, Dooley tells Ramirez and Li to gear up. He puts Ramirez on Thompson's team for the mission to Belarus.
stages.whoA: His chief, who sends him to Belarus
stages.whoB: An agent he sends to Belarus

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Honicky mistakes Dottie for a job applicant and puts a hand on her knee. She breaks his hand, kills him with his own dental drill, and uses his office as a sniper nest facing the SSR.
stages.whoA: The applicant who kills him in his office
stages.whoB: A dentist she kills to use his office

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Brannis pays McFee to use his milk truck to move stolen nitramene. When Peggy finds them at McFee's house, Brannis tries to escape in the truck and she takes him away in it.
stages.whoA: The man who pays to use his milk truck
stages.whoB: The milkman whose truck he uses

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Peggy finds nitramene in McFee's truck, and he attacks her in his living room. She knocks him out and ties him to a chair. Later, from jail, he picks her photo out for Sousa as the woman who left with Brannis.
stages.whoA: The woman who beats him and leaves him tied up
stages.whoB: The milkman she fights for the nitramene truck

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Sousa visits McFee in jail and offers him a lighter sentence. McFee looks at Peggy's photo and swears she is the woman who beat him and left with Brannis and the nitramene.
stages.whoA: The agent who gets him to name Peggy
stages.whoB: The jailed milkman who identifies Peggy

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Dooley and Thompson find McFee hobbling down the road still tied to a chair. Dooley promises to keep an open mind, and McFee admits a woman beat him and tied him up.
stages.whoA: The SSR chief who picks him up on the road
stages.whoB: The milkman found tied to a chair

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Thompson rides with Dooley when they find McFee tied to a chair on the road. They tell him they know Brannis paid him to use the truck and that he is in deep water.
stages.whoA: An agent who arrests him with Dooley
stages.whoB: The milkman who lent Brannis his truck

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Gloucester tells Chadwick the Council is shutting down Isodyne's program and that he should focus on his Senate race. When Chadwick brings Whitney before the Council, Gloucester thanks him and signals the attack on her.
stages.whoA: The councilman he orders to drop Isodyne
stages.whoB: The Council leader who overrules him

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Whitney shows the Council her power over Zero Matter, and Gloucester thanks Chadwick and says they agree how to proceed. Guards try to choke her, and she kills them, then absorbs Gloucester and several other members.
stages.whoA: Chadwick's wife, whose power he tries to end
stages.whoB: The Council leader who orders her death

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Vega works under Sousa in Los Angeles and teases him over his engagement. Secretly loyal to Masters, he helps beat Sousa, then finds him in the desert and holds him at gunpoint until Thompson has him arrest Sousa.
stages.whoA: His chief, whom he betrays for Masters
stages.whoB: An agent who turns on him for Masters

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Masters sends Vega and Blackwell to beat Sousa and later to kill whoever closed the rift. When Vega brings his prisoners back alive, Masters demands to know why, and Vega blames Thompson's orders.
stages.whoA: The man he secretly serves inside the SSR
stages.whoB: One of his men inside the SSR

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: In the desert Vega turns his gun on Thompson, but Thompson talks him out of it and has him take Sousa in alive. After Masters falls, Vega is locked up and, afraid of Thompson, names all of Masters' men.
stages.whoA: The chief who talks him down, then breaks him
stages.whoB: One of Vernon's boys, who fears him

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Violet, the nurse who helped Sousa through his therapy, now shares a home with him. He proposes and she says yes, but after watching him with a wounded Peggy she sees he loves Peggy and ends the engagement.
stages.whoA: Her boyfriend, then fiance, who loves Peggy
stages.whoB: His nurse girlfriend, then fiancee

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Violet meets Peggy over cookies at the office and warmly invites her to dinner with Sousa. Later she stops the bleeding when Sousa and Jarvis carry Peggy in impaled on rebar, and offers to let her stay.
stages.whoA: The friend she patches up, whom Sousa loves
stages.whoB: Sousa's warm nurse fiancee

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Yauch sits in on Dooley's briefings about Stark. With Peggy on the run, Dooley leaves him to watch Ivchenko and keep him in the room.
stages.whoA: His chief, who has him guard Ivchenko
stages.whoB: An agent he trusts to watch Ivchenko

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Yauch joins Thompson on the La Martinique raid. Later Thompson mispronounces his name, waves off his worries about Ivchenko, and sends him to make coffee, and Yauch grumbles that Thompson gets the good cases.
stages.whoA: The lead agent who brushes him off
stages.whoB: An agent on his raids who resents him

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Yauch and Krzeminski back up Thompson at La Martinique and find Spider Raymond dead. Later Krzeminski begs him to swap a night shift, and Yauch says he cannot.
stages.whoA: A fellow agent who asks him to cover a shift
stages.whoB: A fellow agent who will not swap shifts

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Left to guard Dr. Ivchenko, Yauch opens up to him and falls under his spell. He draws a map of the office's exits, then follows Ivchenko's order to have a bourbon and step in front of a truck.
stages.whoA: The Soviet doctor who hypnotizes him to his death
stages.whoB: The agent he hypnotizes into dying

stages.title: Agent Carter (One-Shot)
stages.text: Flynn keeps Peggy on code breaking and never sends her out. After she takes the Zodiac mission alone, he calls her Captain America's old flame, then has to tell her she will run S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoA: The agent he sidelines until Stark promotes her
stages.whoB: Her dismissive SSR boss

stages.title: Agent Carter (One-Shot)
stages.text: Flynn promises to discipline Peggy when Stark calls the case line. Stark orders him to tell Peggy she will run S.H.I.E.L.D. with him, and to say he is honored to bring the news.
stages.whoA: The caller who orders him to honor Peggy
stages.whoB: The SSR man he orders to give Peggy the news

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Mike wants to buy his son Ace an Avengers toy, then saves a woman from a blast in front of him. When Raina takes Ace to control him, Mike hands Coulson over to get his son back. HYDRA later holds Ace to keep Mike, now Deathlok, in line, until Skye frees him.
stages.whoA: His father, who fights to keep him safe
stages.whoB: His young son

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Skye looks after Ace when his father panics, and again after Raina's exchange for Coulson. When HYDRA holds Ace at Cybertek, Skye frees the prisoners and gives him a Hulk action figure.
stages.whoA: The S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who frees him
stages.whoB: Mike Peterson's son, whom she frees

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Raina finds Ace and answers his call to his father, telling Mike to give himself up for his son. At the exchange, she trades Ace for Coulson.
stages.whoA: The woman who holds him hostage
stages.whoB: Mike Peterson's son, her hostage

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Jiaying trusts her cloning Inhuman to guard Raina, and she carries Jiaying to safety when she is shot. She then leads the seizure of the Iliad and fights Skye on Jiaying's order.
stages.whoA: The Afterlife leader she serves
stages.whoB: A loyal Afterlife Inhuman who can copy herself

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: The cloning Inhuman's copies guard Skye in her cell aboard the Iliad until Mack knocks one out. On Jiaying's order, she and her copies beat Skye down until May and Lincoln step in.
stages.whoA: The S.H.I.E.L.D. agent she beats on the Iliad
stages.whoB: An Afterlife Inhuman who beats her with her copies

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Coulson sends Daisy and Mack to help Alisha when Lash attacks one of her copies. Later, Hive takes over both their minds, and they serve him side by side.
stages.whoA: An Inhuman agent who later serves Hive beside her
stages.whoB: An Inhuman who later serves Hive beside her

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: The cloning Inhuman and Lincoln seize the Iliad together for Jiaying. When her copies beat Skye, Lincoln turns on her and shocks her unconscious.
stages.whoA: A fellow Inhuman who turns on her
stages.whoB: An Afterlife Inhuman he shocks to stop her

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: When Hive takes Alisha's mind, Lincoln comes to bring her in, and her copies nearly beat him and May. One copy is shot dead by the other, and Coulson shoots the second.
stages.whoA: A fellow Inhuman who turns on her
stages.whoB: An Inhuman he fights to save from Hive

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Hive takes over Alisha's mind, and she sends her copies against Lincoln and May for him. She joins his Inhumans in his plan for a new village, then dies fighting a Kree Reaper.
stages.whoA: The Inhuman who rules her mind
stages.whoB: An Inhuman under his control who can copy herself

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Alisha offers to help, and Coulson sends her copy to warn the Hensons about Lash. Shaken by her copy's death, she is brought to the Playground. After Hive takes her, Coulson shoots one of her copies.
stages.whoA: The S.H.I.E.L.D. Director she helps hunt Lash
stages.whoB: An Inhuman who helps him hunt Lash

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: In the Framework, Alistair raised Leo himself, and his son is now the Doctor, second in command of HYDRA. Alistair praises his cruelty and scolds him when he loses his temper. When Simmons holds him at gunpoint, Alistair calls Leo in, and Leo finds him dead.
stages.whoA: His son, the Doctor of HYDRA
stages.whoB: His father in the Framework, a HYDRA leader

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Simmons confronts Alistair at his home and blames him for what Leo has become in the Framework. He warns his son that she is there and attacks her, and Simmons shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: The fugitive who shoots him
stages.whoB: Leo's cruel father in the Framework

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: When HYDRA holds Radcliffe, Alistair beats him for news of the rebels and learns only that he spoke with Daisy. Later, Radcliffe and the Doctor find Alistair's body.
stages.whoA: A captive he beats for answers
stages.whoB: A HYDRA leader who beats him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Alistair toasts HYDRA's win over the Patriot with his son and Madame Hydra. When she is badly hurt in the escape from the Triskelion, he takes charge of the hunt for the rebels.
stages.whoA: Madame Hydra, his son's lover
stages.whoB: The Doctor's father, a HYDRA leader

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Petrov tells Malick that Androvich killed the Prime Minister's aide, and they plan to use the general to kill the Prime Minister. When S.H.I.E.L.D. breaks up the meeting, both men die trying.
stages.whoA: A Russian official he plots with
stages.whoB: The Inhuman general in his plot

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Malick advises Petrov to use Androvich's power to kill the Prime Minister, who opposes the Inhuman sanctuary. Androvich unleashes his shadow when S.H.I.E.L.D. breaks in.
stages.whoA: The HYDRA leader who backs his plot
stages.whoB: An Inhuman Russian general he means to use

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Bobbi sees that the shadow can only be stopped through Androvich himself. She finds him among the guards and shoots him at point blank range.
stages.whoA: The agent who shoots him dead
stages.whoB: An Inhuman general she kills to stop his shadow

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Daisy and Hunter fight Androvich's shadow while Mack gets the Prime Minister out, but they cannot touch it.
stages.whoA: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who fights his shadow
stages.whoB: An Inhuman general whose shadow she fights

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Anon books Fitz and Simmons a meeting with Radcliffe and takes them to his hidden room. When he suspects them of HYDRA, he has her set off an EMP and call his guards.
stages.whoA: The scientist she works for
stages.whoB: His cybernetic assistant

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: At a party in Bucharest, Anon agrees to set up a meeting with Radcliffe for Fitz and Simmons. When Radcliffe suspects them, she cuts their comms and calls the guards who take Simmons away.
stages.whoA: A scientist she brings to Radcliffe
stages.whoB: Radcliffe's cybernetic assistant

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Anon takes Fitz and Simmons to Radcliffe's hidden room to test their eye implant. When Radcliffe suspects them, she cuts their comms and calls his guards.
stages.whoA: A scientist she brings to Radcliffe
stages.whoB: Radcliffe's cybernetic assistant

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Daisy bursts into Radcliffe's meeting, knocks Anon down, and takes Radcliffe.
stages.whoA: The Inhuman who knocks her down
stages.whoB: Radcliffe's assistant, whom she knocks down

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: At the Taipei symposium, Petrov proposes an Inhuman sanctuary while Malick exposes Coulson. In Russia, Petrov asks Malick for advice, and Malick tells him to kill the Prime Minister.
stages.whoA: The HYDRA leader who guides his plot
stages.whoB: A Russian official he steers to murder

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Hunter and Bobbi stow away on Malick's plane while Petrov meets him there. In Russia, Petrov tries to shoot the Prime Minister, and Hunter shoots him first.
stages.whoA: The man who shoots him
stages.whoB: A Russian official he shoots to save the Prime Minister

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Hayward helps break Po out of prison for Centipede. When S.H.I.E.L.D. catches him, Raina and Po watch through his eye and flip the switch that kills him.
stages.whoA: The Centipede handler who kills him
stages.whoB: A Centipede soldier she silences

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Coulson's team tracks Hayward through his sister and runs into his ambush in Oakland, where Coulson's Night-Night shot does nothing to him. Once he is down, Coulson tries to question him, but his eye implant kills him.
stages.whoA: The agent whose team hunts him
stages.whoB: A Centipede soldier his team takes down

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Ward finds Hayward's sister Laura and tells her that her brother won the lottery. Worried, Laura calls Hayward, and the lead brings the team to him in Oakland.
stages.whoA: An agent who tracks him through his sister
stages.whoB: A Centipede soldier he tracks through his sister

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: In the Framework, Coulson teaches Burnell's class and tells him never to say that HYDRA came from the Nazis. Later, Coulson helps free Burnell and other children from a HYDRA center.
stages.whoA: His history teacher
stages.whoB: A student who questions HYDRA

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Simmons catches Burnell spraying HYDRA LIES on her car and snaps that his world is not real. She apologizes, he lends her his car, and she tells him that every last one of HYDRA were Nazis.
stages.whoA: A stranger he lends his car to
stages.whoB: A student who lends her his car

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Burrows runs Director Mace's public relations and tells him the public loves him even more after his debate with Nadeer. After a sniper's attack, he flies with Mace to safety and dies when the Quinjet is hit.
stages.whoA: The Director whose image he manages
stages.whoB: His public relations aide

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Mack snaps at Burrows for worrying about bad press while lives are at stake, and Mace defends him. Burrows later flies with Mack, Coulson and Mace when their Quinjet is attacked.
stages.whoA: An agent who scorns his worry about bad press
stages.whoB: Mace's PR man, who worries about bad press

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Chief Wellins keeps Deke locked up after he is picked up drunk, while Deke rambles that he is saving the world. When Daisy arrives posing as his social worker, Wellins lets him go.
stages.whoA: A drunk he jails who claims he is saving the world
stages.whoB: The police chief who jails him in River's End

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Daisy poses as Deke's social worker, Sinara Smith, and Chief Wellins releases Deke into her care. Later, his police call in a sighting of her, and he shares what he knows with General Hale.
stages.whoA: A fake social worker who takes Deke off his hands
stages.whoB: The police chief she fools to free Deke

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: General Hale comes to the River's End police station after its call about Daisy. Wellins tells her what little he knows about Deke Shaw, the drunk Daisy bailed out.
stages.whoA: The general hunting Daisy, whom he helps
stages.whoB: A police chief who gives her a lead on Daisy

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Coulson's team boards the train to track Mancini's package, with Mancini as their target. When the team is exposed, Mancini's men knock Coulson and Ward out with a sedative and leave them behind.
stages.whoA: The S.H.I.E.L.D. agent tracking his package
stages.whoB: Cybertek's security chief, his target

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Mancini catches Ward trying to warn Simmons that the team has been made. He and his men chase Ward and Coulson off the train and knock them out with a sedative.
stages.whoA: An agent he chases off the train
stages.whoB: The security chief who chases him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Mancini and Quinn catch Skye in Quinn's basement as she tries to free Mike Peterson. Mancini takes her Night-Night gun, and she watches as he fits the new leg.
stages.whoA: Skye, whom he catches at gunpoint
stages.whoB: Cybertek's security chief, who catches her

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Mancini opens the package and fits the Cybertek leg onto Mike's stump, proud as it works. Then Mike tells him the Clairvoyant is unhappy, throws him out a window and kills his whole team.
stages.whoA: The man he fits with a new leg, who kills him
stages.whoB: The security chief who fits his leg

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Mancini delivers Cybertek's package to Quinn's villa and helps him hold Skye at gunpoint. Quinn thanks him for his work and sends his team to wait for their pay.
stages.whoA: The buyer of his package
stages.whoB: Cybertek's security chief, who delivers his package

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot
stages.text: Cecilio interrupts Director Mace's talk with Yo-Yo to remind him of his call with the National Security Advisor. Mace thanks him and asks him to escort Yo-Yo to the lab.
stages.whoA: Director Mace, his boss
stages.whoB: A guard on his staff

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Cecilio guards Mace's office and announces Coulson and May, and Mace sends him off for a coffee. Later he reminds the Director that he has to stay on schedule during his tests.
stages.whoA: Director Mace, his boss
stages.whoB: A guard who keeps him on schedule

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot
stages.text: Mace asks Cecilio to escort Yo-Yo to the lab, where Fitz and Simmons will finish her registration. She thanks Mace and tells Cecilio to lead the way.
stages.whoA: Yo-Yo, whom he escorts to the lab
stages.whoB: A guard who escorts her to the lab

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Daisy tries to save Charles as Hydra pulls him away, and his touch gives her a vision. On the roof he saves her from Malick at the cost of his life, and she promises to protect his daughter, Robin.
stages.whoA: Daisy, who promises to protect his daughter
stages.whoB: An Inhuman who gives his life to save her

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Hydra holds Charles at Malick's dinner with Hive and at Transia. On the roof he touches Malick to stop him killing Daisy, showing him his death, and Malick crushes his throat.
stages.whoA: The Hydra leader who kills him
stages.whoB: A captive Inhuman who shows him his death

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Hydra brings Charles to Hive, who forces him to show Rowan Hamilton a vision of his workers' deaths. Hive then makes the vision come true and plans to keep Charles for his army.
stages.whoA: Hive, who uses his power
stages.whoB: A captive Inhuman whose power he uses

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: In the Framework, Hydra agents pull Chris out of Coulson's history class for tests, and Coulson reminds him to take his bag. Later Coulson spots him in a Hydra center and insists on saving him.
stages.whoA: Mr. Coulson, his teacher
stages.whoB: A student taken from his class

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: As the Hydra center comes down, the Patriot follows Coulson inside to save Chris. May finds him holding the rubble off the boy so he can get away.
stages.whoA: The Patriot, who saves him
stages.whoB: A student he saves from the rubble

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Talbot comes to the Confederacy with Qovas to rewrite Hydra's deal and take a seat. Crixon refuses to let a human join, and Talbot, saying he is no longer human, crushes and absorbs him.
stages.whoA: A human with Gravitonium powers who kills him
stages.whoB: The Confederacy leader he absorbs

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Cal frees Angar from Brynmore and wins his team over with the story of his lost daughter. At the school, Cal has his mask taken off and hands him the microphone to scream at S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoA: Cal, who leads his team
stages.whoB: A recruit with a deadly scream

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Coulson briefs the team on Angar's voice and how it shuts down the nervous system. On the school field, before Angar can scream at the agents, Coulson knocks him out.
stages.whoA: The Director who knocks him out
stages.whoB: A gifted man he takes down

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Bobbi's politician contact in San Juan gets her the fort's plans and keeps the police away, but will not go down into the garrison. Later he arrives early in a suit and slips her a note placing Hydra at the theater.
stages.whoA: Bobbi, his contact in S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoB: Her politician contact in San Juan

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Lash gives Frye the names of Inhumans, and Frye tracks them down for him to kill. When Frye is taken in, Lash tears open the van, drags him onto the road and kills him.
stages.whoA: Lash, who uses him and then kills him
stages.whoB: An Inhuman who tracks targets for him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Daisy finds Frye hiding in a closet during the raid on his home, and her powers make his rash and headaches flare. She rides with him in the van when Lash attacks.
stages.whoA: An Inhuman agent who brings him in
stages.whoB: An Inhuman who tracks targets for Lash

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Coulson questions Frye about Lash and pushes him back down with his hand when he tries to run. Frye tells him that Lash is showing Inhumans mercy.
stages.whoA: The agent who questions him
stages.whoB: Lash's tracker, whom he questions

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Price and Coulson question Frye about how he knew Lash's victims. Price has him moved to an ATCU facility, and Lash kills him on the way.
stages.whoA: The ATCU chief who questions him
stages.whoB: Lash's tracker, whom she questions

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Eva puts her daughter Katya through Terrigenesis and then feeds her victims to keep her going. In Bahrain, Katya watches from hiding as May kills her mother.
stages.whoA: Her daughter, Katya
stages.whoB: Her mother, Eva

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: May goes in alone to bring out the agents held in Bahrain and faces Eva. After a hard fight, May kills her with a broken lamp pole.
stages.whoA: The agent who kills her
stages.whoB: A super-strong woman she kills

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Coulson is brought in to make S.H.I.E.L.D.'s approach to Eva in Bahrain, and offers her S.H.I.E.L.D.'s protection. She tells him all she wants is pain.
stages.whoA: The agent who tries to bring her in
stages.whoB: A gifted woman he tries to bring in

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: As Hydra falls, Fischer warns Hale that S.H.I.E.L.D. has Malick and gives her the device in his vault. He tells her about the Confederacy and makes her the head of the project.
stages.whoA: Hale, the general he hands the project
stages.whoB: The Hydra general who hands her the project

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Talbot comes with soldiers to arrest Fischer as a Hydra traitor. Fischer shouts Hail Hydra and bites a cyanide pill.
stages.whoA: The general who comes to arrest him
stages.whoB: A Hydra traitor he comes to arrest

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: When a fight breaks out at the Siberian site, Hunter pulls the Prime Minister clear and shoots an official who tries to kill him. Later the Prime Minister accuses him of being S.H.I.E.L.D., but lets him walk free.
stages.whoA: The man who saves his life in Siberia
stages.whoB: The Russian Prime Minister he saves

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: When Androvich's shadow comes for the Prime Minister and Hunter, Bobbi shoots the general and is arrested. The Prime Minister insists she is S.H.I.E.L.D., but in the end lets her go.
stages.whoA: The woman who kills Androvich to save him
stages.whoB: The Russian Prime Minister she saves

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Coulson orders his team to protect the Prime Minister from Androvich. Later, posing as an ATCU advisor, he tells him that his own Minister of Defense, General Androvich, was trying to assassinate him.
stages.whoA: An ATCU advisor who explains the coup
stages.whoB: The Russian Prime Minister his team protects

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Cal and Wendell Levi recruit Noche with the Index, and he pulls open Brynmore's gates for them. Moved by Cal's story of his lost daughter, he follows him to the school to take on S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoA: Cal, who leads his team
stages.whoB: A super-strong recruit to his team

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: When Cal vanishes from the school field, Noche goes at May in a brawl. His raw strength is no match for her skill, and she beats him.
stages.whoA: The agent who beats him
stages.whoB: A super-strong brute she beats

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: As children, Francisco and his cousin Elena hide in a closet when a drug dealer comes to the house. Elena slips out to save the family necklace, and his father is shot.
stages.whoA: His cousin
stages.whoB: Her cousin

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Elena steals a bus of guns from the corrupt Bogota police, and her cousin drives them to the river to dump them. He is killed there, and she vows to take him home to his family.
stages.whoA: His cousin, who steals the police guns
stages.whoB: Her cousin, who dumps the guns

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Ramon's police catch up with Elena's cousin on the bridge as he throws away their guns. With Lucio holding everyone still, Ramon shoots him in the head to send a message.
stages.whoA: The police officer who kills him
stages.whoB: A man he kills for dumping his guns

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Bobbi and Hunter catch Elena's cousin throwing the stolen guns into the river and cuff him. Then Ramon's police arrive, paralyze them all and kill him in front of her.
stages.whoA: An agent who catches him at the river
stages.whoB: The man she catches dumping guns

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Lucy frees him from his box at Momentum Labs, but he blames her and the Darkhold for what they have become. He refuses to follow her and stays behind to blow up the lab. Years before, they cheered their first success together, before Eli turned on them.
stages.whoA: A colleague he blames for their fate
stages.whoB: A colleague who turns against her

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Frederick doubts the Darkhold experiment, then celebrates when it works. Eli later turns the machine on him and the others to take its power for himself.
stages.whoA: The colleague who betrays him
stages.whoB: A colleague he betrays

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: As the ghost scientist reaches for Fitz at Momentum Labs, Ghost Rider grabs him, makes him solid and burns him away.
stages.whoA: Ghost Rider, who destroys him
stages.whoB: A lab ghost he burns away

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Mack and Fitz search the empty Momentum Labs as the reactor builds. The ghost scientist toys with Mack, then locks him inside the machine.
stages.whoA: An agent he traps in the lab
stages.whoB: A ghost who traps him in the lab

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: At Momentum Labs the ghost scientist sets the reactor to explode and goes after Fitz. Ghost Rider stops him just before he can touch him.
stages.whoA: An agent he tries to infect
stages.whoB: A ghost who nearly touches him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Ponarian returns to the Lighthouse for Kasius's auction and asks after the Vrellnexians he sold him. He needles Kasius about his exile, then bids for Ben until Kasius has him killed instead.
stages.whoA: His host, who sells Inhumans
stages.whoB: A bidder at his auction

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Posing as Boshtok the Marauder, Fitz mocks Ponarian and his snails at dinner to win Kasius over. When the agents break free, Fitz strikes Ponarian in the face and knocks him out.
stages.whoA: Boshtok, a rude rival bidder
stages.whoB: A bidder he knocks out

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Ponarian comes to the Lighthouse eager to buy Quake as a slave. He watches her defeat Sinara in the arena just before the agents escape.
stages.whoA: Quake, the prize he wants to buy
stages.whoB: A bidder who wants to buy her

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Flint trades Gretch a tin can for a token before his Terrigenesis. When Kasius cuts the power and sets loose the Vrellnexians, she tells him to turn himself in, but he later helps save her from one.
stages.whoA: A boy she trades with
stages.whoB: A regular customer

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Mack defends Flint when Gretch blames him for Kasius's reprisal. He then helps kill the Vrellnexian attacking her in the Salvage.
stages.whoA: A stranger who saves her
stages.whoB: A resident he saves

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Yo-Yo helps kill the Vrellnexian that attacks Gretch in the Salvage. When the humans rise up, Yo-Yo cuts out Gretch's Metric first.
stages.whoA: The woman who cuts out her Metric
stages.whoB: The first resident freed of a Metric

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Coulson once ran the program that wiped a S.H.I.E.L.D. spy's memory and gave him a new life as Hank. He holds Hank at gunpoint for answers, Hank frees him from Derik, and Coulson tells him the truth and offers him his old job.
stages.whoA: The man who gave him a new life
stages.whoB: A former agent from Tahiti

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Derik, another Tahiti patient, ties up Hank's family and Coulson in the garage. Hank frees himself, catches Derik's thrown knife and uses it to cut Coulson loose.
stages.whoA: A former patient who hunts him
stages.whoB: A fellow patient he hunts

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: May sedates Hannah to get her away from the angry crowd. Later May takes her off the Bus to lure Tobias Ford out, and convinces him to let her go.
stages.whoA: The agent who protects her
stages.whoB: A woman she protects

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Coulson's team comes to Batesville to check Hannah for powers. He questions her on the Bus, where she says God is punishing her, before the team learns she is the victim.
stages.whoA: The agent who questions her
stages.whoB: A woman he suspects, then protects

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Skye asks to talk to Hannah as a friend and finally gets her chance. Hannah asks if she believes in God, and Skye later comforts her once Ford is gone.
stages.whoA: Skye, who befriends her
stages.whoB: A woman she befriends

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: In the Framework, Hope and her father build engines and dodge HYDRA, until HYDRA takes them both in. He stays at the Playground to keep her, and holds her as she vanishes.
stages.whoA: Her father
stages.whoB: His daughter in the Framework

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: At the Triskelion, Skye talks kindly to Hope while HYDRA holds her and her father. Later Daisy asks Mack to join a mission, and Hope urges him to help.
stages.whoA: Skye, who is kind to her
stages.whoB: A girl she meets at the Triskelion

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Hope meets Coulson at the Playground, where he warns her that her history book is full of lies. Her father introduces them properly.
stages.whoA: A teacher at the Playground
stages.whoB: Mack's daughter

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Elena comes into the Framework to bring Mack home and rides out with Hope and her father. Hope overhears Elena say she is not real and runs to her father in tears.
stages.whoA: A woman who comes for her father
stages.whoB: Mack's daughter

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Lucy frees Hugo at Momentum Labs and tells him they have been trapped for years. He blames her book but joins her hunt for Eli and goes with her into the prison.
stages.whoA: The colleague who frees him
stages.whoB: A colleague she frees

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Hugo works beside Eli at Momentum Labs until Eli turns the machine on him. Freed years later, Hugo swears Eli must pay and hunts him in the prison.
stages.whoA: The colleague who betrayed him
stages.whoB: A colleague he betrayed

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Hugo and Vincent corner Robbie and Mack in the prison. Hugo slips up on Mack, and Robbie burns him away from behind.
stages.whoA: Ghost Rider, who destroys him
stages.whoB: A ghost he burns away

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: In the prison, Hugo goes invisible and touches Mack, infecting him. Mack injects himself with Fitz's cure in time.
stages.whoA: An agent he infects
stages.whoB: The ghost who infects him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Hugo and Frederick work together at Momentum Labs and cheer their first success. Freed as ghosts, Hugo follows Lucy while Frederick stays behind.
stages.whoA: A colleague who stays behind
stages.whoB: A colleague who follows Lucy

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Hunter and Idaho go undercover as buyers, and Hunter teases him about looking Coulson in the eye. They break off the raid to rush Hartley to a hospital, and only Hunter survives the crash.
stages.whoA: An old mercenary friend
stages.whoB: A mercenary friend

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Idaho works on Hartley's team for Coulson. He drives her away after the Obelisk starts killing her, and both die when Creel flips the car.
stages.whoA: The leader of his team
stages.whoB: A man on her team

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Idaho meets Director Coulson at the Playground debrief. Coulson sends him as the driver on the raid for the Obelisk.
stages.whoA: The Director he works for
stages.whoB: A mercenary on Hartley's team

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Creel bursts in on the buyers' meeting and escapes Idaho's bullets. Later he stands in the road as stone, and Idaho's car crashes into him.
stages.whoA: The man who kills him
stages.whoB: A man he kills in a crash

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: The doctor clears Coulson for his new team. When Coulson learns his memories are false, he hides in the doctor's car, and the doctor tearfully admits he helped bring him back and gave him Tahiti.
stages.whoA: The agent he helped bring back to life
stages.whoB: The doctor who helped revive him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: After clearing Coulson for duty, the doctor asks Hill whether Coulson really knows what happened to him. Hill tells him Coulson can never know.
stages.whoA: A deputy who keeps Coulson's secret
stages.whoB: A doctor who clears Coulson's team

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Hogun follows Thor to Jotunheim and fights the Frost Giants at his side. When Thor is banished, Hogun urges the others to defy Loki, and they find Thor on Earth and bring him home.
stages.whoA: His friend and prince
stages.whoB: One of the Warriors Three

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Hogun and Thor win the battle against the Marauders on Vanaheim. Thor tells him to stay with his people, and Hogun thanks him.
stages.whoA: His friend, who sends him home
stages.whoB: A friend he leaves on Vanaheim

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Hogun saves Sif when she falls in the fight on Jotunheim. They go to Earth together to find Thor and battle the Destroyer side by side.
stages.whoA: Lady Sif, a fellow warrior
stages.whoB: One of the Warriors Three

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Sif and Hogun fight the Marauders together on Vanaheim until Thor arrives to end the battle.
stages.whoA: Lady Sif, a fellow warrior
stages.whoB: A fellow warrior on Vanaheim

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Hogun rides to Jotunheim with Loki and Thor. After Thor is banished, Hogun suspects Loki let the Frost Giants in, and he defies the new king to bring Thor back.
stages.whoA: Thor's brother, a king he defies
stages.whoB: A warrior who suspects him

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Heimdall lets Hogun and the others cross the Bifrost to Jotunheim, and later to Earth to fetch Thor. On their return, the warriors carry the wounded Heimdall to the healers.
stages.whoA: The gatekeeper who lets them pass
stages.whoB: A warrior he lets cross

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Hogun meets Hela with Asgard's army and orders her to surrender. She slaughters the army, mocks him when he rises again and kills him.
stages.whoA: The goddess who kills him
stages.whoB: A warrior who defies her

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Janice meets Derik at a bar, feels she knows him and invites him home. When she sees the alien writing tattooed on him, he attacks her and carves it into her, killing her.
stages.whoA: The man who murders her
stages.whoB: A fellow T.A.H.I.T.I. patient he murders

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: In Coulson's memories, he checks on her as a T.A.H.I.T.I. patient and has her memories replaced with a new life as Janice Robbins. After her murder, he studies her paintings to understand the writing.
stages.whoA: The agent who ran her treatment
stages.whoB: A T.A.H.I.T.I. patient he gave a new life

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Lorelei enthralls newlywed Jimmy at a desert motel, and he leaves his wife behind to drive her away. At a biker bar she finds new followers, frees him from her spell and kills him.
stages.whoA: The Asgardian who enthralls and kills him
stages.whoB: A newlywed she enthralls, then kills

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Lincoln calls his old friend John, who once talked him off a ledge, and John takes him in and sells him his car. After the news calls Lincoln a killer, John calls the hotline and holds him off with a bat. Lincoln's jolt stops his heart, and he dies despite Lincoln's efforts.
stages.whoA: His old friend, on the run
stages.whoB: The friend who once saved his life

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Beckers debates Senator Ward on TV, saying his plan to hunt S.H.I.E.L.D. agents destroys citizens' rights. Ward tells him Belgium is welcome to take S.H.I.E.L.D. in if it wants.
stages.whoA: A U.S. senator he debates on TV
stages.whoB: A Belgian official he debates on TV

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Kaminsky greets Garrett with a HYDRA salute at the Barbershop, then fires on him from a helicopter to fool the guards at the Fridge. He helps carry the failing Garrett to a table, and Garrett leaves him to guard the Barbershop.
stages.whoA: His HYDRA commander
stages.whoB: A pilot who joins his HYDRA team

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Kaminsky's helicopter fires on Ward and Garrett so the Fridge guards will trust them, then he joins the raid. Later he helps Ward carry the failing Garrett to a table.
stages.whoA: A fellow HYDRA agent under Garrett
stages.whoB: A HYDRA pilot on Garrett's team

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: When Coulson's team raids the Barbershop, Kaminsky waits for them with the Berserker staff. May takes the staff from him and uses it to bring the base down on him.
stages.whoA: The agent who takes his staff
stages.whoB: A HYDRA pilot she buries in rubble

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Zabo recruits Karla into his revenge crew and frees her hands from S.H.I.E.L.D.'s shackles. She doubts the plan, but his story about his lost daughter wins her over. When he vanishes at the school, she takes command.
stages.whoA: The man who recruits her for revenge
stages.whoB: A razor-fingered recruit for his crew

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Bobbi goes over Karla's file with Coulson, then hides beneath the bleachers at the school. When Karla leads the attack, Bobbi fights her staves against nails and knocks her into a wall.
stages.whoA: The agent who beats her at the school
stages.whoB: A killer with razor fingernails

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Coulson studies Karla's Index file as Zabo's crew gathers. At the school she holds unconscious students in the bleachers to draw him out, and his team arrests her.
stages.whoA: The S.H.I.E.L.D. Director she wants to punish
stages.whoB: An Index killer in Zabo's crew

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Turgeon supervises Simmons in the HYDRA lab and lets her coach him for a report to his superiors. Weeks later they share a project, and he is blamed as the mole she really is.
stages.whoA: The undercover agent he supervises
stages.whoB: Her supervisor in the HYDRA lab

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Bakshi sends Turgeon and Simmons to Whitehall's meeting. When evidence turns up at Turgeon's desk, Bakshi's men knock him out and drag him away.
stages.whoA: The HYDRA officer who drags him off
stages.whoB: A lab supervisor accused of spying

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Bobbi, working HYDRA security, announces a mole in the lab, and the search finds evidence at Turgeon's desk. He tells her it is not his before he is dragged away.
stages.whoA: A HYDRA security chief who accuses him
stages.whoB: A lab supervisor caught in her search

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: In the Framework, May comes to Turgeon's HYDRA lab for his new serum. He explains what is in it and promises one dose will leave the Patriot begging for his life.
stages.whoA: A HYDRA agent who takes his serum
stages.whoB: A HYDRA scientist with a serum

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Zeller runs the soldier handlers at Cybertek for Garrett and reports when May brings the Barbershop down. Skye then uses Zeller's phone to warn Garrett that Coulson is coming.
stages.whoA: His HYDRA boss
stages.whoB: His handler at Cybertek

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Skye storms the handlers' room with a bomb, straps it to Zeller and guesses he is a pawn of the Incentives Program. She drags him to the dormitories, frees his wife, and shows him the bomb is a toy.
stages.whoA: The agent who frees his wife
stages.whoB: A coerced handler she bluffs

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: May and Skye bluff their way into the handlers' room at Cybertek. May holds off Ward while Skye takes Zeller to free his wife.
stages.whoA: An agent who storms his control room
stages.whoB: A Cybertek handler she helps capture

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Russo's men take May after she leaves the train, and he stabs her while offering her Cybertek's money. She breaks free and later kills him with a thrown knife before he can shoot Coulson.
stages.whoA: The agent who kills him
stages.whoB: Italian contact who tortures her

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Coulson asks Russo to help get his team onto the Cybertek train. Russo sells them out, then comes to the Bus hiding a gun until May stops him.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who trusts him
stages.whoB: Italian contact who betrays him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Lucio is Colonel Ramon's Inhuman enforcer in the Colombian police. Together they ambush Bobbi and Hunter, and Lucio keeps them frozen while Ramon questions them.
stages.whoA: His commander in the Colombian police
stages.whoB: His Inhuman enforcer

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Lucio freezes Bobbi and Hunter so Ramon can take them. Under questioning at the station, Bobbi mocks him as Medusa eyes.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. agent he paralyzes
stages.whoB: Colombian cop whose stare paralyzes

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Yo-Yo storms the police station to free Bobbi and Hunter and snaps a cuff on Lucio. He freezes her first, and she slams into a wall.
stages.whoA: Inhuman who cuffs him in the raid
stages.whoB: Police Inhuman who freezes her

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: In the raid on the station, Joey melts Lucio's sunglasses onto his face. Later Lucio ambushes the Secret Warriors for HYDRA, and Joey kills him.
stages.whoA: The Inhuman who kills him
stages.whoB: HYDRA's Inhuman, whom he kills

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Lucio tries to freeze Hive when HYDRA brings him in, but Hive breaks through and takes him over. Lucio then freezes five humans for Hive to feed on.
stages.whoA: The Inhuman who enthralls him
stages.whoB: An Inhuman in his thrall

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Giyera brings the captured Lucio to Hive. Once Hive takes Lucio over, the two of them gather five healthy humans for Hive.
stages.whoA: Malick's Inhuman, who brings him to Hive
stages.whoB: An Inhuman who serves Hive with him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Banks leads Price's ATCU teams hunting Inhumans and reports every escape to her. After she is killed, he joins S.H.I.E.L.D. to go after the man who took her.
stages.whoA: His boss, head of the ATCU
stages.whoB: Her right-hand man

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Mack and Banks hunt Lincoln together and end in a standoff until their bosses make a deal. Mack later tails Banks as a Lash suspect, then welcomes him at the Playground after Price dies.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who tails, then trusts him
stages.whoB: Price's ATCU man

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Banks threatens Daisy with snipers when Lincoln slips away, then works beside her on the Lash case. Daisy suspects he is Lash and tails him, but his blood test clears him.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. Inhuman who suspects him
stages.whoB: ATCU agent she suspects of being Lash

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Hunter knocks Banks out on the street so Simmons can test his blood. At Endotex, Banks chases the undercover Hunter, then leads him and Bobbi out once Price learns HYDRA is inside the ATCU.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. agent he leads to safety
stages.whoB: ATCU agent who gets him out of Endotex

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Banks and Giyera both work at Endotex, where Giyera serves HYDRA in secret. At the Distant Star facility, Giyera seizes Banks's gun, makes him shoot the S.H.I.E.L.D. team, and kills him with it.
stages.whoA: HYDRA's Inhuman, who kills him
stages.whoB: ATCU agent he kills with his own gun

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Banks comes to the Playground to avenge Price and tells Fitz and Simmons about Project Distant Star. He takes them into the facility, where Giyera kills him in front of them.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. scientist he guides
stages.whoB: ATCU agent killed in front of him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Banks holds Coulson at gunpoint when he corners Price on a train, until Coulson disarms him with his prosthetic hand. Once Price and Coulson join forces, Banks works beside his team on the Lash case.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. Director who disarms him, then works with him
stages.whoB: Price's ATCU man

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Scarlotti's fake S.H.I.E.L.D. squad storms Talbot's UN meeting, and his splinter bomb breaks Talbot's arm. After May beats him, he is taken away under Talbot's watch.
stages.whoA: General whose UN meeting he attacks
stages.whoB: Mercenary who attacks the UN

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: May bursts into the safe house where Scarlotti lies in wait for S.H.I.E.L.D. agents. He knocks the gun from her hand with his rope dart, but she takes his blade and knocks him down.
stages.whoA: The agent who beats him
stages.whoB: HYDRA's hired killer, whom she beats

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Hunter walks into the safe house claiming to be a fellow merc and stalls Scarlotti for May and Bobbi. Scarlotti kicks him down when the agents burst in.
stages.whoA: Merc who bluffs his way in
stages.whoB: HYDRA's hired killer

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Bobbi names Scarlotti as the UN attacker, an assassin who once nearly killed Barton. She crashes into the safe house with May and fights his men.
stages.whoA: Agent who identifies him
stages.whoB: Assassin she identifies

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Marta's men hold Fitz and Ward in a bar while she decides their fate. Fitz shorts her power, then fixes it, wins her over, and pays her to get them across the border.
stages.whoA: Captive engineer who wins her over
stages.whoB: Ossetian boss who smuggles them

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Captured with Fitz, Ward waits on Marta's verdict in her bar. Once Fitz wins her favor, she gets them both across the border.
stages.whoA: Captive agent she helps
stages.whoB: Ossetian boss who smuggles them

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Mertz shows Elena and her friends a trick at a Miami party. When the Watchdogs try to shoot him as the Inhuman, she grabs their guns and gives herself away to save him.
stages.whoA: Party guest who saves his life
stages.whoB: A party magician she saves

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Skye warns her boyfriend Miles that S.H.I.E.L.D. is coming and joins him in Austin. When she learns he sold data for a million dollars, she breaks it off and says goodbye in Hong Kong.
stages.whoA: Skye, his hacker girlfriend
stages.whoB: Her hacker ex-boyfriend

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Coulson has Miles brought in for the hack that got Chan kidnapped. After Miles helps vent Chan's blast, Coulson puts a tracking bracelet on him and leaves him in Hong Kong.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who punishes him
stages.whoB: A hacker he leaves in Hong Kong

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Faulnak puts Maston-Dar over Sinara in the hunt, and the two use Flint as bait. As Maston-Dar blasts through the wall to the fugitives, Sinara shoots him from behind.
stages.whoA: Kasius's warrior, who kills him
stages.whoB: Faulnak's warrior, whom she kills

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Maston-Dar corners the fugitives in the gravity room and shoots Fitz in the stomach. Daisy gets Fitz away while the room fills with smoke.
stages.whoA: A fugitive he shoots
stages.whoB: Kree hunter who shoots him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Maston-Dar stands behind Faulnak as Daisy fights Sinara in the Crater. Sent to bring her in, he hunts her through the Lighthouse, and she disarms him in the smoke.
stages.whoA: The Destroyer he is sent to capture
stages.whoB: Faulnak's hunter

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Coulson ambushes Maston-Dar and Sinara to free Flint. Maston-Dar knocks him down, but Coulson's prosthetic punches and Mack's pipe hold him off.
stages.whoA: Agent who outfights him
stages.whoB: Kree warrior he fights

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Ellis rebrands Rhodey's armor as the Iron Patriot and sends him after the Mandarin. When Savin uses the stolen suit to kidnap Ellis, Rhodey frees him on the Norco.
stages.whoA: The colonel he makes the Iron Patriot
stages.whoB: The President he serves

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Killian has Ellis flown to the Norco in the Iron Patriot suit and plans to burn him on live TV so the Vice President takes power. Tony and Rhodey stop him.
stages.whoA: The man who plans to kill him on TV
stages.whoB: The President he means to execute

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Savin, wearing the stolen Iron Patriot armor, kills Ellis's guards on Air Force One. He seals the President inside the suit and sends him to Killian.
stages.whoA: Extremis soldier who kidnaps him
stages.whoB: The President he abducts

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Ellis meets Coulson where Rosalind died and agrees to back S.H.I.E.L.D. in secret, though he will not move on Malick. He names Talbot to run the ATCU and joins Coulson in Moscow to calm the Russians.
stages.whoA: The Director he backs in secret
stages.whoB: The President, his secret backer

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Nathanson blocks Coulson and Mack at the lab door until Simmons tells him to leave them be. When May falls ill, Simmons calls him over to help.
stages.whoA: Scientist who gives him orders
stages.whoB: A lab agent she orders around

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Director Mace sends Nathanson with Aida to Radcliffe's lab to collect the LMD research. It is the last job Nathanson is given.
stages.whoA: The Director who sends him to Radcliffe's
stages.whoB: An agent he sends to Radcliffe's lab

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Nathanson escorts Aida back to Radcliffe's lab. When he finds May bleeding in a hidden room, Aida says she is sorry and snaps his neck.
stages.whoA: The android who kills him
stages.whoB: Agent she kills to hide May

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: O'Brien works the Bahrain op where May backs up Coulson. Under Katya's control he fights May, who frees him by killing the girl.
stages.whoA: The agent who frees him in Bahrain
stages.whoB: An agent she frees in Bahrain

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: O'Brien volunteers for May's strike team against Hive in Union City. Their shots do nothing to Hive, and May orders a retreat.
stages.whoA: Leader of his strike team
stages.whoB: An agent on her strike team

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: In Bahrain, O'Brien watches the bar while Coulson talks to Eva Belyakov. When Coulson calls after the team is taken, the entranced O'Brien tells him to leave them alone.
stages.whoA: Agent on the Bahrain op
stages.whoB: An agent on the Bahrain op

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
