stages.whoA: His first mate
stages.whoB: His captain

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Powell spots Achilleo hiding at Ariana's restaurant and beats him down in the alley. In a cell he tortures Achilleo for Christofi's whereabouts.
stages.whoA: The Task Force officer who tortures him
stages.whoB: The fugitive captain he catches

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Buck sends Powell out and talks gently to Achilleo, who begs to go home. Buck agrees none of it is his fault and shoots him in the head.
stages.whoA: His killer
stages.whoB: The captain he executes

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Achilleo watches Daredevil fight through his crew on the ship's cameras and sinks the Northern Star with him aboard. Matt then hunts for him to protect him, too late.
stages.whoA: The masked man who boards his ship
stages.whoB: The captain who sinks the ship on him

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Achilleo comes to Ariana for help, and she hides him and plans to get him to Toronto and on to Cyprus. The Task Force finds him at her restaurant and takes him.
stages.whoA: The captain she tries to smuggle out
stages.whoB: The restaurateur who hides him

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Matt finds Ariana after the raid and they agree to try to help Christofi. Later Daredevil frees her from the Task Force cells and works out of her hideout.
stages.whoA: The lawyer, and Daredevil, who frees her
stages.whoB: The restaurateur who hides people

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Powell raids Ariana's restaurant, strikes her when she calls the Task Force fascists, and seizes Achilleo. During the breakout, his officers open fire on her and the other prisoners.
stages.whoA: The Task Force officer who beats her
stages.whoB: A smuggler hiding his targets

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Christofi was hidden thanks to Ariana, and he says she was captured for helping him. He comes to her hideout to tell the resistance about the Northern Star.
stages.whoA: The first mate she shelters
stages.whoB: The woman who was jailed for helping him

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Karen and Angela pull Ariana and the other escaped prisoners into an armored truck under fire. Ariana tells them she knows a place to hide.
stages.whoA: One of her rescuers
stages.whoB: An escaped prisoner with a hideout

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Both are freed from the Task Force cells and hide together. They record testimony about being caged for weeks, played to protesters against Fisk.
stages.whoA: A fellow freed prisoner
stages.whoB: A fellow freed prisoner

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Ariana and Berto escape the Task Force cells together and hide at her safe place. Both record testimony about their arrests under Fisk.
stages.whoA: A fellow freed prisoner
stages.whoB: The woman who hides the escapees

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Steverud tells Fisk his Safer Streets moves need oversight, then folds after a call from de Fontaine. Later he files charges against Fisk and offers him exile in place of prosecution.
stages.whoA: The mayor he first backs, then charges
stages.whoB: The Attorney General

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Mr. Charles barges into Steverud's meeting with Fisk and mocks him. Steverud insists he won't be intimidated, then takes the call Charles tells him to take and backs down.
stages.whoA: The CIA man who makes him back down
stages.whoB: The Attorney General he cows

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: The Governor calls Steverud and tells him to move on the paperwork to suspend Fisk. She warns him that their window is now.
stages.whoA: The Governor
stages.whoB: Her Attorney General

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Dr. Merati promises Fisk he will do all he can for Vanessa and reports a hopeful surgery. After she dies he consoles Fisk, who crushes him to death.
stages.whoA: The mayor whose wife he treats
stages.whoB: Vanessa's surgeon, whom he kills

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Dr. Merati takes on Vanessa's case after she is wounded and operates on her. He tells Fisk the long surgery went well.
stages.whoA: His critical patient
stages.whoB: Her surgeon

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: At his fundraiser, Artemis tells Fisk his port project is a self-serving con and that her circle still decides who gets to eat. Later she comes to his ball afraid to offend him.
stages.whoA: The mayor she scorns, then fears
stages.whoB: A socialite who mocks his plans

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Jack greets Artemis warmly at Fisk's ball and is surprised she came. When he asks after her husband Arthur, she rushes away.
stages.whoA: A fellow socialite
stages.whoB: A fellow socialite

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Hochberg prosecutes Hector Ayala with Matt for the defense, and Matt's White Tiger reveal infuriates him. Hochberg vows his ADAs will hound Matt, then loses the verdict.
stages.whoA: The defense lawyer who beats him
stages.whoB: The District Attorney

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Matt walks into Karen's trial and objects to Hochberg's case. Over Hochberg's objections Matt questions Fisk, and the court dismisses the charges.
stages.whoA: Karen's lawyer, who wrecks his case
stages.whoB: The prosecutor trying Karen

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Hochberg, her old boss, urges Kirsten to plead out Duquesne and come back to the DA's office, and she tells him off. He then beats her in Duquesne's rigged trial and faces her again at Karen's.
stages.whoA: His former protege, now opposing counsel
stages.whoB: Her old boss at the DA's office

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Hochberg has Hector remanded and argues he killed Officer Shanahan. After the White Tiger reveal he tells the jury a masked man can't be trusted, but Hector is acquitted.
stages.whoA: The defendant he prosecutes
stages.whoB: The District Attorney prosecuting him

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Hochberg calls Powell as his witness and walks him through Shanahan's death. Powell claims Hector attacked them unprovoked.
stages.whoA: His star witness
stages.whoB: The District Attorney

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Powell takes the stand for Hochberg at Karen's trial. Both stand on Fisk's side of the vigilante trials.
stages.whoA: A witness for the prosecution
stages.whoB: The prosecutor

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Hochberg calls Heather about her report on Duquesne and nudges her to make him look like a sociopath. At Karen's trial he has her read from her book on masked men.
stages.whoA: The psychiatrist whose report he uses
stages.whoB: The District Attorney

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Fisk orders Hochberg to charge Karen with everything and convict her on all of it. When Fisk takes the stand, Hochberg advises him not to answer, and Fisk waves him off.
stages.whoA: The mayor who gives him orders
stages.whoB: The District Attorney doing his bidding

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Hochberg charges Karen with aiding Daredevil and inciting a riot and paints her as a sociopath in court. The judges dismiss the case with prejudice.
stages.whoA: The defendant he prosecutes
stages.whoB: The prosecutor trying her

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Hochberg prosecutes Jack at the first vigilante trial, reading Heather's report to cast him as a killer. The judges find Jack guilty.
stages.whoA: The defendant he convicts
stages.whoB: The prosecutor who convicts him

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Foggy defends Benny for stealing wine from a Red Hook warehouse and hides him in his apartment after threats. Benny calls him in a panic as an intruder breaks in.
stages.whoA: His lawyer
stages.whoB: His thief client

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Javi tries to swipe a drink from Berto's bodega, and Berto pulls a shotgun on him. The Task Force storms in and drags Berto away.
stages.whoA: The bodega owner who pulls a gun on him
stages.whoB: The kid stealing from his store

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Soledad greets Berto at his bodega and begs him not to shoot Javi. Both are freed from the Task Force cells and record testimony against Fisk.
stages.whoA: A regular, and a fellow prisoner
stages.whoB: Her neighborhood bodega owner

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Daredevil breaks Berto out of the Task Force cells with the other prisoners. Berto then hides with Daredevil's allies and records his story.
stages.whoA: Daredevil, who frees him
stages.whoB: A prisoner he frees

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Javi teases Angela in the bodega before the raid, and later she trusts him to deliver an SD card. When he is knocked down at the protest, she screams for him.
stages.whoA: His friend from the neighborhood
stages.whoB: Her friend from the neighborhood

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Posing as a fan asking for a photo, Javi slips BB the SD card Angela gave him.
stages.whoA: The reporter he passes the SD card to
stages.whoB: The fan who passes her an SD card

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Levine wants young Matt and Foggy to get Lionel McCoy to plead out. When McCoy goes to a public defender, Levine berates them and has them collate the files all weekend.
stages.whoA: A young associate under him
stages.whoB: His boss at Landman and Zack

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Levine scolds Foggy for calling him Jeff instead of Mr. Levine. He dumps the McCoy files on Foggy and Matt for the weekend.
stages.whoA: A young associate under him
stages.whoB: His boss at Landman and Zack

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Cooper denies Matt's bail request for Hector Ayala but sides with him in chambers, keeping White Tiger out of the trial. When Matt reveals Ayala is White Tiger anyway, Cooper calls him slippery for misleading the court but lets the trial go on.
stages.whoA: Defense lawyer in the Ayala trial
stages.whoB: Judge in Hector Ayala's trial

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Cooper remands Hector without bail on the charge of killing a police officer. After the jury finds him not guilty on every count, Cooper tells him he is free to go.
stages.whoA: Defendant he jails, then frees
stages.whoB: Judge who denies bail, then frees him

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Held hostage together at New York Mutual Bank, Johnny tells Matt the vault holds only safety deposit boxes. When the police clear the bank, Johnny vouches that Matt was a hostage.
stages.whoA: Fellow hostage at the bank
stages.whoB: Fellow hostage who vouches for him

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Johnny tells Mayor Fisk he voted for him and has worked in Sanitation for 35 years. He then reveals that Muse's mural is made of human blood, and Fisk sends for Gallo.
stages.whoA: The mayor he reports to
stages.whoB: Sanitation worker who finds the blood

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Sheila brings Johnny to Fisk's office with urgent news about the mural. When he rambles, she pushes him to tell the Mayor what he told her.
stages.whoA: Aide who brings him to the Mayor
stages.whoB: Sanitation worker with urgent news

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Gomez and the Attorney General confront Fisk over his emergency powers and the Safer Streets Initiative. He later stands beside Governor McCaffrey as she warns Fisk she can revoke Red Hook's free port status.
stages.whoA: Mayor he challenges for the state
stages.whoB: Lieutenant Governor who challenges him

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Gomez tells Governor McCaffrey the Red Hook charter came from an anonymous source, and she tells him nothing is anonymous. Later he tells Buck Cashman she promised to back his run for her office.
stages.whoA: The Governor he serves
stages.whoB: Her Lieutenant Governor

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Gomez demands to know what the CIA is doing in Fisk's office. Mr. Charles mocks his job title and calls him Juan.
stages.whoA: CIA man who mocks him
stages.whoB: Lieutenant Governor he mocks

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: At the Gracie Mansion dinner, Daniel pumps a drunk Gomez for talk about the Governor. Gomez insists she is squeaky clean, but Daniel says everybody has something.
stages.whoA: Fisk aide fishing for dirt
stages.whoB: Lieutenant Governor he pumps for dirt

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: At Vanessa's wake, Gomez tells Buck that McCaffrey promised to support his candidacy. Buck asks why he should wait and hints he may not need to campaign at all.
stages.whoA: Fisk's fixer who tempts him
stages.whoB: Lieutenant Governor he sounds out

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Shanahan and Powell rough up their informant Nicky Torres in a subway station, and Shanahan dies in the fight with Hector Ayala. On the stand, Powell calls Kel his partner of eight years and his best friend.
stages.whoA: His partner and best friend
stages.whoB: His late partner and best friend

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Hector steps in as Shanahan and Powell beat Nicky Torres. Shanahan charges him, misses, trips and falls in front of a train, and Hector is charged with his murder.
stages.whoA: The man he charges on the platform
stages.whoB: Cop whose death he is tried for

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Shanahan and Powell accuse their informant Nicky of dodging them and start beating him on a subway platform. Shanahan grabs him, then lets go to help Powell, and Nicky runs.
stages.whoA: Informant he beats
stages.whoB: Cop who beats him

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Matt takes Leroy's caramel corn theft case, and Leroy insists on probation while mocking his blindness. Matt wins him ten days and loses his temper, then listens as Leroy explains how the system keeps grinding him down.
stages.whoA: His lawyer
stages.whoB: Client in a caramel corn theft

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Lionel, who bullied Foggy as a boy, turns up as his client and refuses a plea deal. Foggy finds the flaw in the warrant that frees him, then gives him the firm's savings to start over, and Lionel says he never had a friend like that.
stages.whoA: Childhood neighbor who gives him a fresh start
stages.whoB: Childhood bully he saves

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Matt and Foggy are assigned to get Lionel to plead out, but he mocks Matt's blindness and refuses. Matt doubts he deserves to walk, yet helps get the charges thrown out over the bad warrant.
stages.whoA: One of his lawyers
stages.whoB: Client freed on a bad warrant

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Vanessa runs the Five Families table and rules that Red Hook is exempt from Luca's toll. Luca later urges her to take back control and get rid of Wilson, and her text sends him into Buck Cashman's ambush.
stages.whoA: She runs the Five Families table
stages.whoB: Five Families boss she sets up

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Luca barges into the Mayor's office and refuses to pay Viktor, so Fisk raises his debt to $2.8 million. Luca later sneaks up on Fisk at a restaurant with a gun, and Buck shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: The Mayor he tries to kill
stages.whoB: Mob boss who defies him

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Luca demands a toll from Viktor's trucks, and Viktor reminds him Red Hook is exempt. After a deadly hijacking, Luca is ordered to pay Viktor $1.8 million and refuses.
stages.whoA: Rival Five Families boss
stages.whoB: Rival Five Families boss

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Buck tells Luca he owes Viktor $1.8 million, and Luca calls him the mayor's errand boy. When Luca moves on Fisk at a restaurant, Buck is waiting and kills him.
stages.whoA: Fisk's fixer who kills him
stages.whoB: Mob boss he kills

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Vanessa scolds Viktor for being rude at the Five Families table but backs him on the Red Hook toll. The meeting ends when Wilson Fisk walks in.
stages.whoA: She runs the Five Families table
stages.whoB: Five Families boss she backs

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Buck settles the hijacking feud for the Fisks and rules that Luca owes Viktor $1.8 million. Viktor is satisfied with the terms.
stages.whoA: Fisk's fixer who rules in his favor
stages.whoB: Five Families boss owed restitution

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Matt finds Nicky first and sends him out the fire escape before the cops arrive to silence him. On the stand, Nicky lies that he was home all night, and Matt withdraws him as a witness.
stages.whoA: Lawyer who saves him
stages.whoB: Key witness who lies

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Powell and Shanahan accuse Nicky of dodging them and beat him in a subway station. Powell later tracks him to his apartment to stop him from testifying.
stages.whoA: Cop who beats him
stages.whoB: Informant he beats

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Hector breaks up the beating Nicky is taking from two cops, and Nicky runs. Called to back Hector's story at trial, Nicky lies and says he was never there.
stages.whoA: The man who saved him
stages.whoB: Man he saved, who lies in court

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Grace helps her brother Vickie hold Maya at the skating rink for a cartel bounty. When Maya slips her zip ties, Grace points a gun at her until Vickie stops her. Maya later texts her a photo of a beaten guard.
stages.whoA: The woman she held for the bounty
stages.whoB: Vickie's sister, one of her kidnappers

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Grace grabs Bonnie outside the skating rink after Henry quietly warns her to leave. Bonnie is locked up with Maya and then dragged out again by Grace and the others.
stages.whoA: Maya's cousin, whom she grabbed outside
stages.whoB: One of the kidnappers at the rink

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Vickie brings in his sister Grace to help him hold Maya for the cartel. She scolds him for stalling the deal with Zane, and when Zane has Vickie shot, Grace flees and Zane lets her go.
stages.whoA: His sister and partner in the kidnapping
stages.whoB: Her brother, shot during the deal

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Henry has employed Vickie for years at the skating rink and in his other business. Vickie turns on him to sell Maya, ties him up and says he takes no more orders. Henry warns him that Zane will cross him.
stages.whoA: His longtime boss at the rink
stages.whoB: His rink worker, who turns on him

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Vickie tips Zane off that Maya is back and promises to have her ready. When Zane arrives without the money and Vickie keeps pushing for it, Zane has him shot and thanks him for the tip.
stages.whoA: The cartel boss he sells Maya to
stages.whoB: The rink worker who tipped him off

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Vickie brushes Maya off at the rink counter, then reports her to the cartel. He has her kidnapped and held in a storage room, insisting she be kept alive so he gets paid.
stages.whoA: The woman he sells out for a bounty
stages.whoB: The rink worker who sells her out

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: When Bonnie comes looking for Henry, Vickie forces Henry to send her away, then has her grabbed and locked up with Maya.
stages.whoA: Henry's niece, whom he locks up
stages.whoB: One of the kidnappers at the rink

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: A Tracksuit kicks a dog outside the auction until Kate kicks him in the face, and he later firebombs her apartment. Held captive, Kate gives Tomas advice about his girlfriend. At Rockefeller Center he thanks her because it worked, then attacks her anyway.
stages.whoA: The archer who fixed his love life
stages.whoB: The Tracksuit she gave love advice

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Clint fights off Tomas and the Tracksuits to save Kate, then lets them capture him so Tomas can question him. In the Ronin suit, Clint later drags Tomas under a car and knocks him out.
stages.whoA: The Avenger he kidnapped
stages.whoB: One of the Tracksuits who held him

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Tomas works for Maya in the Tracksuit Mafia. He rides with her in the chase after Clint and Kate escape, and stands guard at the car lot when she goes to meet Ronin.
stages.whoA: His leader in the Tracksuits
stages.whoB: One of her Tracksuits

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Tomas rides beside Maya as she leads the Tracksuits in their chase after the archers.
stages.whoA: His leader in the Tracksuits
stages.whoB: One of her Tracksuits

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Kazi, Maya's second in command, gives the Tracksuits their orders and tells Tomas to go with Maya in the chase. Tomas helps him pack up the toy store hideout once the archers escape.
stages.whoA: Maya's second in command
stages.whoB: One of the Tracksuits under him

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Outside the auction, a dog bites the Tracksuit holding the watch, and he kicks at it until Kate stops him.
stages.whoA: The dog that bit him at the auction
stages.whoB: The Tracksuit who kicked him

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Maya's father tells her she cannot go to a deaf school but can learn by watching, and takes her to karate. Ronin kills him at the hideout, and he dies in her arms, telling her to fly away.
stages.whoA: His daughter
stages.whoB: Her father, killed by Ronin

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: After Maya's mother dies, William comforts the injured Maya and takes her to New York. There he tells her to jump between two worlds and to make a better life than his.
stages.whoA: His daughter
stages.whoB: Her father

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: At the hospital, William tells his mother-in-law he has killed the people who cut the brakes. She blames him for her daughter's death and tells him to leave, and he takes Maya to New York.
stages.whoA: His wife's mother, who blames him
stages.whoB: Her late daughter's husband

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: William and his wife sit by the fire with her family before she drives Maya to the store. Someone cuts her brakes and she dies in the crash.
stages.whoA: His wife, killed in a crash
stages.whoB: Her husband

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Skully visits Maya at the hospital with William and her grandmother. When the grandmother turns on William, Skully tells him she is only grieving.
stages.whoA: A family elder who stands by him
stages.whoB: Maya's father

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Jack is the son of Phastos and Ben, and Phastos checks his teeth and tucks him in when Ikaris and Sersi come calling. Phastos leaves to rejoin the Eternals, and afterward father and son watch the Domo leave Earth together.
stages.whoA: His father, secretly an Eternal
stages.whoB: His young son

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Ben and Phastos are raising Jack together. Ben tells Phastos to go with the Eternals if it means they can watch Jack grow up.
stages.whoA: His father
stages.whoB: His son with Phastos

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: When a toaster gives Thena trouble, Jack tells her life is complicated for him too. She conjures a spear to fetch him an orange, and Phastos scolds her for showing his son violence.
stages.whoA: His father's friend, an Eternal
stages.whoB: Phastos's son

stages.title: Eyes of Wakanda
stages.text: High Councilor Rakim scolds Basha for taking the whole statue head and warns him not to treat missions like a contest. When the gallery is found wrecked, Basha calls it a training drill, and Rakim leaves him to clean it up.
stages.whoA: An agent under his command
stages.whoB: His High Councilor

stages.title: Eyes of Wakanda
stages.text: Rakim sends Ebo away so he can speak with Basha alone. Told that the wrecked gallery was Ebo's training drill, Rakim congratulates him and promotes him to field operative.
stages.whoA: An officer he promotes
stages.whoB: His High Councilor

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Peter brings the Orb to the Broker's shop on Xandar to sell it. The moment Peter mentions Ronan, the Broker refuses the deal and throws him out.
stages.whoA: A Ravager who tries to sell him the Orb
stages.whoB: A Xandar dealer who refuses the Orb

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Yondu meant to sell the Orb through the Broker. After Peter runs off with it, Yondu threatens the Broker in his shop until he names the Collector as his buyer.
stages.whoA: A Ravager captain who threatens him
stages.whoB: A dealer he forces to talk

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Kraglin comes with Yondu to lean on the Broker, who gives up the Collector as his buyer.
stages.whoA: One of Yondu's Ravagers
stages.whoB: A dealer Yondu threatens

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Now neighbors on Knowhere, the Broker plays cards with Kraglin. When Cosmo keeps moaning about being called a bad dog, the Broker begs Kraglin to take it back, and Kraglin refuses.
stages.whoA: A card partner on Knowhere
stages.whoB: A card partner on Knowhere

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Drax, out for revenge, holds a knife to the dispatcher's throat on Knowhere. He forces him to send Ronan a message calling him there to fight.
stages.whoA: A man who threatens him at knifepoint
stages.whoB: A dispatcher he forces to call Ronan

stages.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
stages.text: The dispatcher spends Christmas on Knowhere with Kraglin and their neighbors. He is disgusted when Cosmo gives Kraglin a dead Orloni as a present.
stages.whoA: A friend on Knowhere
stages.whoB: A friend on Knowhere

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Steemie jeers at Kraglin's clumsy practice with the arrow and laughs when Cosmo shows him up. In the battle, Kraglin tells Steemie he's up, and Steemie fires Knowhere's cannon at the lab.
stages.whoA: A friend who flies Knowhere
stages.whoB: Steemie, a friend on Knowhere

stages.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
stages.text: Bzermikitokolok's band plays Peter a song they wrote about Christmas. Peter points out that much of what it says about Christmas is wrong.
stages.whoA: The Guardian who owns Knowhere
stages.whoB: A Knowhere bandleader

stages.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
stages.text: Kevin Bacon joins Bzermikitokolok's band on stage for a Christmas song while the Guardians swap presents. Afterward, the band watches him head home to Earth.
stages.whoA: A guest singer from Earth
stages.whoB: The bandleader he sings with

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Bzermikitokolok plays cards with Kraglin and the others on Knowhere. When the High Evolutionary's creatures invade, Kraglin fights them off with the arrow to protect him and the other residents.
stages.whoA: A card partner who defends Knowhere
stages.whoB: A card partner on Knowhere

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Caught stealing from OrgoCorp, Fitz-Gibbonok refuses to tell Ayesha where Gamora is. After he dies, Ayesha takes his communicator and tricks Gamora into sending her location.
stages.whoA: The Sovereign priestess who questions him
stages.whoB: A Ravager she questions

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Ayesha tells Adam to show the captured Fitz-Gibbonok they mean business. Adam disintegrates him instead, leaving them nothing to learn from him.
stages.whoA: The Sovereign who kills him
stages.whoB: A Ravager he kills

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Fitz-Gibbonok rides with the Ravagers who meet the Guardians, and he dies refusing to give Gamora away. Gamora later calls him on his communicator, not knowing Ayesha now holds it.
stages.whoA: A fellow Ravager
stages.whoB: A fellow Ravager

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Peter flirts with Ura at her desk under the name Patrick Swayze, then has her pull Rocket's file once Gamora draws a gun. At the security hub she sets up the monitor for him, and he uses it to hack the Orgosentries and escape.
stages.whoA: A Guardian who flirts with her as Patrick Swayze
stages.whoB: An OrgoCorp manager who helps him

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Gamora barges in on Ura and holds her at gunpoint to get Rocket's file. When the Orgosentries close in, Gamora takes her hostage to get the Guardians out.
stages.whoA: A Ravager who takes her hostage
stages.whoB: An OrgoCorp manager she takes hostage

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Vim serves the High Evolutionary as one of his Recorders and takes his scorn when Rocket slips away. As his lab breaks apart, she defies him and tries to take command of the ship, and he kills her.
stages.whoA: Her master
stages.whoB: One of his Recorders

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: War Pig reports to Vim that she has 89P13 and is on her way back. Vim then tells the High Evolutionary that they have the subject.
stages.whoA: The guard sent to fetch Rocket
stages.whoB: The Recorder she reports to

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: War Pig guards the High Evolutionary's lab and scans the Guardians who come to see him. On his order she flies to the Bowie to bring him Rocket.
stages.whoA: Her master
stages.whoB: A guard who serves him

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Gamora finds War Pig carrying Rocket off the Bowie and orders her to drop him at gunpoint. War Pig slams her into a wall and flies on.
stages.whoA: A Ravager who tries to stop her
stages.whoB: A guard who takes Rocket

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Adam crashes into War Pig on the Bowie to take Rocket for himself. She protests that they work for the same boss, but he says he needs the credit and tears off her head.
stages.whoA: The Sovereign who kills her
stages.whoB: A rival guard he kills

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Armand is Jack's uncle and tells Kate he has done everything he can to talk Jack out of marrying Eleanor. At the auction he warns Jack that things are about to get ugly, and the two bid against each other for Ronin's sword.
stages.whoA: His nephew, engaged to Eleanor
stages.whoB: His disapproving uncle

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: At the gala Armand tells Eleanor he knows what she is hiding and threatens her with powerful friends of his own. That same night he is found dead, and Eleanor later admits to Kingpin that she handled Armand as he asked.
stages.whoA: Jack's fiancee, whom he threatens
stages.whoB: Jack's uncle, who threatens to expose her

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Armand greets Kate at the gala, recalls her childhood brunches at his brownstone and lets slip that her mother is engaged to Jack. Kate overhears him threaten Eleanor, then finds him dead in his home that night.
stages.whoA: The Bishops' daughter, an old family friend
stages.whoB: Jack's uncle, an old family friend

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Young Armand VII interrupts Armand III at the gala to say he is bored. Armand III scolds his manners and makes him say hello to Kate.
stages.whoA: The young Armand of the family
stages.whoB: The elder Armand of the family

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: At Eleanor's Christmas party Armand VII is surprised to see Jack out of jail and sulks that he may not get Jack's wine collection after all. Jack reminds him of the time he wet his pants in the Hamptons.
stages.whoA: The relative whose wine he hopes to inherit
stages.whoB: The young relative who wants him back in jail

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Caudle calls Kate to question her about the fire at her apartment, but she never comes in. After the battle at Rockefeller Center he arrests her mother for Armand's murder.
stages.whoA: The witness he calls in about the fire
stages.whoB: The detective who arrests her mother

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Caudle arrests Jack at the Bishop penthouse after Eleanor's call, pointing to tax records that tie him to Sloan Limited. Jack insists he has been framed.
stages.whoA: The man he arrests for Sloan Limited
stages.whoB: The detective who arrests him

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Caudle acts on Eleanor's tip and takes Jack away. On Christmas Eve he arrests Eleanor herself for the murder of Armand Duquesne the Third.
stages.whoA: The killer he arrests
stages.whoB: The detective who arrests her

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Enrique robs the auction under Kazi and follows him after Ronin, urging him to retreat when the police arrive. He later watches as Kazi and Maya question the captured archers.
stages.whoA: The Tracksuit leader he follows
stages.whoB: One of his Tracksuit thugs

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Enrique is one of Maya's Tracksuits who capture Clint and keep him at their toy store hideout. He watches as Maya questions Clint and Kate.
stages.whoA: His gang's boss
stages.whoB: One of her Tracksuit thugs

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Clint knocks Enrique down when he rescues Kate from the Tracksuits. Enrique later clubs Clint with a bat, taunts him on a kiddie ride and chases the archers across the Manhattan Bridge.
stages.whoA: The archer he captures and taunts
stages.whoB: A Tracksuit thug who calls him bro

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Enrique corners Kate in the Ronin suit, then helps firebomb her apartment until her arrow knocks his bottle away. At Rockefeller Center he gets a gun on her but is stopped before he can shoot.
stages.whoA: The archer he hunts
stages.whoB: A Tracksuit thug who hunts her

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: At Rockefeller Center Enrique points a gun at Kate, and Jack disarms him with his sword. Jack then knocks him out with a punch.
stages.whoA: The swordsman who knocks him out
stages.whoB: A Tracksuit he knocks out

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Missy runs the LARP where Grills duels Clint for the Ronin suit and declares Grills the winner. She and Grills join the deal for new costumes and help clear the guests from Eleanor's party.
stages.whoA: Her fellow LARPer
stages.whoB: His fellow LARPer, who makes costumes

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Missy and Orville are in the same LARP guild and join the deal to help the archers for new costumes. At Eleanor's party they work undercover and then lead the guests to safety in their LARP gear.
stages.whoA: Her fellow LARPer
stages.whoB: His fellow LARPer

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Missy stops Clint at her LARP, signs him up and referees his duel with Grills. She later makes him a new suit and helps guard Eleanor's party for him.
stages.whoA: Hawkeye, whom she signs up and suits up
stages.whoB: The LARP organizer who makes his new suit

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Kate tries on Missy's handmade Viking costume and asks her to make her next one. At Rockefeller Center Missy brings Kate her bow and helps clear the civilians.
stages.whoA: The archer she makes a suit for
stages.whoB: The LARPer who makes her new suit

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Orville cheers Grills on in his LARP duel with Clint. Grills tells Orville they are getting new costumes, and the two help evacuate Eleanor's party together.
stages.whoA: His LARP guildmate
stages.whoB: His LARP guildmate

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Orville watches Clint lose his LARP duel to Grills, then signs on to help him for new costumes. At Eleanor's party Clint sends him to find Eleanor, and Orville reports that she is gone.
stages.whoA: Hawkeye, whom he helps at the party
stages.whoB: A LARPer who helps guard the party

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Orville fist bumps Kate when she agrees to get the LARPers new costumes. On Christmas Eve he works the coat check at her mother's party as part of her plan.
stages.whoA: The archer who recruits his guild
stages.whoB: A LARPer who helps her

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Becca trains at Colleen's dojo, and Colleen recalls finding her pickpocketing on the train. When Colleen comes to her for antibiotics, Becca sends her into a trap and hands her to the Hand, saying the Hand comes first.
stages.whoA: Her sensei, whom she betrays
stages.whoB: Her former student, who betrays her

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Big Al meets the newly returned Danny in the park, looks him up on a found iPhone and tells him where to get shoes. He shares a thrown-out chicken parm with Danny, who later finds him dead and prays over him.
stages.whoA: A barefoot stranger he befriends
stages.whoB: A homeless friend in the park

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Albert employs Danny as a mover and teases him that Colleen will be his own future wife. He tells Danny not to come in as a Triad war breaks out, and later his crew spreads the word about Davos.
stages.whoA: His mover and friend
stages.whoB: His boss at the moving company

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: After Davos kills Ho, Chen Wu begs for his life and offers to lead him to every Triad in the city. He drives Davos from one killing to the next, comes to believe in him and guards Joy while Davos goes after Danny.
stages.whoA: The master he guides to the Triads
stages.whoB: Ho's man, who serves as his guide

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Chen Wu fights Colleen when the peace meeting collapses and loses an eye. When they meet again outside James Wong's apartment he tries to give her the same, but she beats him.
stages.whoA: The fighter he blames for his eye
stages.whoB: Ho's bodyguard, who hunts her

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Chen Wu listens in on Joy's talks with Davos and is there when she admits to freeing BB. He guards her after Davos throws her from the balcony and refuses her bribe, saying money means nothing to him now.
stages.whoA: Davos's partner turned prisoner
stages.whoB: Davos's guard who holds her

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Chen Wu knocks Misty's gun away when she comes to rescue Joy and fights her hand to hand. After a stray shot hits his neck, Misty tries to stop the bleeding.
stages.whoA: The detective he fights at Eden Towers
stages.whoB: Davos's guard, who fights her

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Mary arrives as Chen Wu lies bleeding from Ward's shot. She shoots him twice, saying it was better to put him out of his misery.
stages.whoA: The woman who kills him
stages.whoB: Davos's wounded guard, whom she kills

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Crank and Ryhno's gang train under Davos, whom they call Shifu. Crank kills Ryhno for wanting out, tracks down BB for him and stabs BB in his name.
stages.whoA: Shifu, the master he serves
stages.whoB: His most loyal disciple

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Crank and BB are in Ryhno's gang together, and BB scoffs at Davos's training while Crank defends it. When BB begs him to leave Shifu's fight, Crank agrees Chinatown needs leaders, then stabs him.
stages.whoA: His gang brother, whom he kills
stages.whoB: A gang brother who turns on him

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Colleen finds Crank stabbing BB and beats the gang. Crank taunts that BB got his and comes at her with a knife, but she disarms him before the police arrive.
stages.whoA: The fighter who stops him
stages.whoB: BB's killer, whom she beats

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Crank and Chen Wu both serve Davos at Eden Towers. When BB flees with the bowl, Crank brings Davos and Chen Wu word that BB is hiding at Bayard.
stages.whoA: Davos's one-eyed guide
stages.whoB: One of Davos's young disciples

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Donnie finds Misty watching Mariah's interrogation and tells her she cannot be there. Misty later says Chang pulled her out of the observation room.
stages.whoA: His friend and fellow detective
stages.whoB: A detective and good friend

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Misty tells Danny and Colleen that her good friend Donnie Chang is undercover in the Golden Tigers. She visits him in the hospital, where he says a man with a glowing fist wrecked the sting.
stages.whoA: His friend and fellow detective
stages.whoB: A detective and good friend

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Chang works the Harlem's Paradise standoff under Inspector Ridley, handing her the call from inside the club. He tells her the hostages' statements do not match the story that Luke is the shooter.
stages.whoA: The inspector he reports to
stages.whoB: A detective on her standoff team

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Chang is undercover among the Golden Tigers when Danny breaks up the peace meeting. Danny's glowing fist leaves him with six broken bones and his sting in ruins.
stages.whoA: The man who wrecks his sting
stages.whoB: A Golden Tiger he beats

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Colleen spends weeks hunting Frank Choi over her family's box. When they finally meet he tells her the pirate queen story that came with it, which tells her that her mother was in New York.
stages.whoA: The woman who owns the box he took
stages.whoB: The forger who had her family's box

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Misty learns that Frank Choi cut a deal to inform on the Golden Tigers and gets the feds to let Colleen question him. She walks him out afterward.
stages.whoA: The detective who brings him in
stages.whoB: An informant she brings to Colleen

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Danny warns Yang that the Hand forced Rand Enterprises to take his pier. He returns with Colleen to rally Yang against Madame Gao, and Yang's men join the raid on the Hand's warehouse.
stages.whoA: The Iron Fist who rallies him against the Hand
stages.whoB: The Triad boss he teams with against the Hand

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Danny urges Yang to make peace with the Golden Tigers and smashes his desk when Yang insists on blood for blood. After Davos strikes him down, Yang uses his last strength to tell Danny where Davos's cargo is coming in.
stages.whoA: The Iron Fist who pushes him to make peace
stages.whoB: The Triad boss who gives him Davos's secret

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Colleen comes with Danny to win Yang and his men over against Madame Gao. She fights beside them in the raid on the Hand's warehouse.
stages.whoA: Danny's partner in the raid on the Hand
stages.whoB: The Triad boss who joins their raid

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Colleen helps talk Sherry Yang into pushing her husband toward peace. She and Danny visit the bedridden Yang, who whispers the clue about Davos's cargo before Sherry throws them out.
stages.whoA: The sensei who helps push him toward peace
stages.whoB: The Triad boss who whispers Davos's secret

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Mariah offers Yang a deal to run his heroin through Harlem, and they shake on it though it breaks her family's old rule. He backs her before the other crime bosses and helps her bait Bushmaster.
stages.whoA: The Harlem boss who opens Harlem to his heroin
stages.whoB: The Chinatown heroin boss she partners with

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Yang sells heroin under Bushmaster's name to draw him out. Bushmaster storms the warehouse to confront him, and Yang slips away as his men open fire.
stages.whoA: The man he baits with heroin in his name
stages.whoB: The Triad boss who puts poison out in his name

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: When Yang's men open fire on Bushmaster at the warehouse, Luke shields him. Luke and Bushmaster beat Yang's crew while Yang escapes.
stages.whoA: The bulletproof man who wrecks his trap
stages.whoB: The Triad boss whose crew he fights

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Davos pays Yang to bring a shipment through his docks and kills two of his men when Yang raises the price. When Yang backs out to make peace with the Tigers, Davos embraces him and leaves him struck down by a stroke.
stages.whoA: The client who strikes him down
stages.whoB: The Triad boss who goes back on his word

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Ward comes to Yang asking what he knows about the Hand and tells him to name his price. Yang refuses money, tells him the tale of a man the Hand kept bringing back, and warns him his only way out is to run.
stages.whoA: Harold Meachum's son, who comes to him for answers on the Hand
stages.whoB: The Triad boss who warns him about the Hand

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Heather comes home with Wendell to find young Danny bullied over a board game by Ward. On the family jet she leaves her seat to hold Danny and tell him she loves him, moments before she is pulled from the plane.
stages.whoA: Her son
stages.whoB: His mother, lost in the crash

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Heather and Wendell come home together to Danny and the Meachum children. On the jet Wendell begs her to stay in her seat as the plane breaks apart, and he loses her.
stages.whoA: Her husband
stages.whoB: His wife

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Colleen drives a street gang away from Henry outside his restaurant, then beats them when they come back to threaten his staff. Grateful, Henry admits that Frank Choi is his cousin.
stages.whoA: The sensei who saves his restaurant
stages.whoB: The restaurant owner she saves from a gang

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Ryhno's crew tries to shake Henry down for protection money and threatens his staff until Colleen stops them. Later Ryhno comes back at Davos's side to apologize, and watches Davos kill him.
stages.whoA: The restaurant owner he shakes down
stages.whoB: The gang leader who extorts him

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Davos brings Ryhno's crew to apologize to Henry and offers him free protection. When Henry says he wants no part of any side, Davos calls him a Tiger and kills him.
stages.whoA: The man who kills him for staying neutral
stages.whoB: The restaurant owner he kills

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Ward has Jennifer brought in for a private interview and rants over bourbon about Danny selling the new cure at cost. She leaves with the story Ward wanted told.
stages.whoA: The Rand CEO who feeds her a story
stages.whoB: The Bulletin reporter he uses for good press

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: At Danny's welcome press conference Jennifer asks if he was committed to Birch, and he admits it. Her story then praises him as a corporate hero.
stages.whoA: The heir she questions, then praises in print
stages.whoB: The reporter who asks about Birch

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Singleton works as Harold's enforcer, cutting phone lines and cleaning up after his crimes. He stands guard at Harold's penthouse until Bakuto's men burst in.
stages.whoA: The boss he cleans up after
stages.whoB: His enforcer

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: A thug knocks Danny down in the hospital records room, and they fight while the files go up in flames. He gets away while Danny pulls a woman from the fire.
stages.whoA: The heir whose records he burns
stages.whoB: The man who burns his hospital records

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Singleton cuts Wilkins's phone line and guards the door while Harold confronts him. After Harold shoots Wilkins, Singleton makes it look like a suicide.
stages.whoA: The board member whose murder he covers up
stages.whoB: Harold's man who stages his suicide

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Bakuto's men storm Harold's penthouse. They shoot Singleton before he can fire.
stages.whoA: The leader whose men gun him down
stages.whoB: Harold's enforcer, shot by his men

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Kyle keeps Harold's secret and runs his errands, from tracing Danny's call to Colleen to picking Harold up after his return. Harold then beats him to death with an ice cream scoop.
stages.whoA: The secret boss who kills him
stages.whoB: His loyal assistant

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Ward finds Kyle working at Harold's side and asks if his father overworks him. Kyle later calls Ward to the penthouse for Harold.
stages.whoA: Harold's son
stages.whoB: His father's assistant

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Wilkins fights Danny's plans to sell the new cure at cost and to shut the chemical plant. He tells Danny the board will not follow a child who knows nothing of business.
stages.whoA: The heir who upends his board
stages.whoB: The board member who fights him

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Wilkins hands Joy and Ward a termination deal. Joy turns it down and vows to take the company back, and he kills the deal.
stages.whoA: The executive he forces out
stages.whoB: The board member who fires her

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Wilkins fires Ward along with Joy. When Ward comes back pleading for a separate severance, Wilkins refuses and says Harold would be ashamed.
stages.whoA: The CEO he fires
stages.whoB: The board member who fires him

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Harold waits in Wilkins's office with proof of his embezzling and tells him to kill himself to spare his son. When Wilkins refuses, Harold shoots him.
stages.whoA: His old partner, back from the dead to kill him
stages.whoB: The board member he kills

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Liu guards the bedridden Yang at his home after the stroke. He drags Danny out when the visit makes Yang's heart race.
stages.whoA: The Triad boss he guards
stages.whoB: One of the men guarding his home

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Liu mocks Danny and throws him out of the Yang home, but later lets Danny and Colleen lead Sherry out ahead of Davos. At Bayard Liu wants to fight Davos while Danny begs them to wait.
stages.whoA: The Iron Fist he first throws out
stages.whoB: Sherry Yang's security chief

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Colleen calms Liu at the Yang home, then fights off an attacker in the street so Liu can get the car and drive Sherry away. At Bayard she persuades him to lead the civilians out.
stages.whoA: The sensei who helps him save Sherry
stages.whoB: Sherry Yang's security chief

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: As Davos hunts the Triad leaders, Liu hides Sherry from him. When Davos reaches Bayard, Liu faces him with his hatchets to cover the escape, and Davos kills him.
stages.whoA: The man he dies fighting
stages.whoB: The Triad guard he kills

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Sam hides Liu and Sherry at Bayard and lets the Triads meet there, though he fears for the families upstairs. Liu insists the families are safer with the Triads around.
stages.whoA: The Bayard worker who hides them
stages.whoB: The Triad guard he lets hide at Bayard

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Megan calls security when a ragged Danny walks in claiming to be Danny Rand, then becomes his assistant once he is back. She finds two of the Hand's warehouses for him, and he asks her to call him Danny.
stages.whoA: The boss she once called security on
stages.whoB: His assistant at Rand

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Joy has her assistant help her study old photos of Danny and ship him a box of candy. The assistant later shows Colleen into Joy's office.
stages.whoA: Her boss at Rand
stages.whoB: Her assistant

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Ward has Megan set up his interview with the reporter Jennifer Many. Later he shouts at her over his emptied trash can.
stages.whoA: Her short-tempered boss
stages.whoB: His assistant

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Joy runs into her old college rival Mika at Bailey's Auction House and wins her over with drinks. Joy secretly records Mika with Davos and uses it to take the Erskine bowl, then sends Misty to her.
stages.whoA: Her college rival who blackmails her
stages.whoB: Her old college rival

stages.title: Iron Fist S2

stages.whoA: The masked woman who beats him
stages.whoB: The bookie's son she beats

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Mrs. De Luca greets Jessica at her old family home and shares stories of her childhood and old gossip with Kilgrave. Under Kilgrave's control she later carries a bomb to Simpson and dies.
stages.whoA: The neighbor girl she watched grow up
stages.whoB: Her family's old next-door neighbor

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Kilgrave invites Mrs. De Luca to breakfast, makes her admit she lies to feel important, and sends her away. He then orders her to hand Simpson his own bomb, and she dies in the blast.
stages.whoA: The man who controls her and sends her to die
stages.whoB: The neighbor he turns into a bomb

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Controlled by Kilgrave, Mrs. De Luca stops Simpson outside the Jones house and hands him a bag holding his own bomb. It goes off as he runs, killing her and his two men.
stages.whoA: The officer she brings Kilgrave's bomb
stages.whoB: The neighbor who brings him his bomb

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Gina picks Luke up at his bar and sleeps with him. Learning she is married, he turns her away, and her husband Andre brings his rugby team to beat Luke.
stages.whoA: The bar owner she has an affair with
stages.whoB: A married woman he sleeps with

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Gina storms Jessica's office over the photos of her with Luke and accuses her of chasing off the competition. Jessica grabs her arm, and Gina reveals Andre's team is on its way to Luke's bar.
stages.whoA: The investigator who photographed her affair
stages.whoB: Luke's married lover, who blames her

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Gor collects Brianna's cut on the street and grabs her for holding money back. He takes her out of Malcolm's apartment, then loses her when Malcolm beats him.
stages.whoA: A woman he runs on the street
stages.whoB: The pimp she works for

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Gor punches Malcolm and takes Brianna back out of his apartment. Malcolm later finds him on the street, beats him down and leaves with Brianna.
stages.whoA: The man who beats him and takes Brianna
stages.whoB: Brianna's pimp, whom he beats

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Grace co-hosts Trish's style program on ARN and plays along when Trish rambles about Mother's Day on air. After Dorothy's murder she welcomes Trish back and praises her strength.
stages.whoA: The star she co-hosts with on ARN
stages.whoB: Her co-host on ARN

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Dorothy warns Grace on set that her blouse shows too much. Later Trish brings Dorothy on air, and Grace welcomes her as a guest.
stages.whoA: Trish's mother, a guest on air
stages.whoB: Trish's co-host

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica stops Spheeris's car by lifting it, and he threatens to tell the world about her. She mocks him with talk of laser eyes and serves him the subpoena.
stages.whoA: The strong woman who serves him
stages.whoB: A club owner she serves with a subpoena

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Griffin dates Trish and panics when she vanishes chasing IGH, then copies a list of names from her computer. He stages a surprise proposal, and she ends the relationship.
stages.whoA: The girlfriend he proposes to
stages.whoB: Her reporter boyfriend

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Griffin helps bail Jessica out and trades dark jokes with her, then turns to her when Trish goes missing. He lures her to his proposal party with a call saying Trish is in trouble.
stages.whoA: Trish's best friend
stages.whoB: Trish's boyfriend

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Griffin lunches with Trish and Dorothy, then enlists Dorothy to bring Trish to his surprise proposal.
stages.whoA: Trish's mother, who helps with his proposal
stages.whoB: Trish's boyfriend

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Inez trades scraps of IGH information for shelter at Jeri's home, then sells her the lie that Shane can heal her ALS. They become lovers until Inez and Shane rob Jeri, and Jeri tricks Inez into shooting Shane.
stages.whoA: The lawyer she seduces and robs
stages.whoB: The con artist she falls for

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Jessica tracks Inez down and learns she was an IGH nurse whose patient broke her back. Jessica arranges for Jeri to keep her safe.
stages.whoA: The investigator chasing IGH
stages.whoB: A former IGH nurse she protects

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Trish helps Jessica find Inez and hears her story of the IGH patient who nearly killed her.
stages.whoA: Jessica's sister, chasing IGH
stages.whoB: A former IGH nurse she helps find

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Inez runs from Malcolm and steals his television. He catches her trying to sell it and takes her to Jeri.
stages.whoA: The man who catches her and takes her to Jeri
stages.whoB: The nurse who steals his television

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Masked, Trish corners Montero at his building and beats a confession out of him. He admits his fires killed 14 people and dies under her blows.
stages.whoA: The masked vigilante who kills him
stages.whoB: An arsonist she beats to death

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica visits Jack posing as a transit investigator. Unable to speak, he spells KIL to confirm Kilgrave, then writes a plea for her to kill him, which she refuses.
stages.whoA: The investigator who asks who took his kidneys
stages.whoB: Kilgrave's mute victim

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Jessica corners Justis on the golf course, and he refuses to give up Malus. She then confronts his son Eric, and Justis agrees to tell her where Malus is.
stages.whoA: The investigator who threatens his son
stages.whoB: Malus's loyal patron

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Justis pays Malus's bills out of gratitude for saving his son. After Jessica's visit he calls to warn Malus about her.
stages.whoA: The doctor who saved his son
stages.whoB: The old friend who pays his bills

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Trish sings at Kyle's daughter's birthday party in exchange for a hospital file. Kyle hands over the pages he copied on Jessica, all he could find.
stages.whoA: The star who sings for his daughter
stages.whoB: The hospital guard who trades her a file

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Laurent turns Jeri away after his father's death and knocks her down, then apologizes. Later he comes to her office and asks her to protect his mother from the lawsuits.
stages.whoA: The lawyer he blames, then asks for help
stages.whoB: Kith's son

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Luke beats up Sirkes's men, then talks Sirkes into a finder's deal for Antoine. At the warehouse Sirkes gets Luke in a headlock, but Luke throws a table at him and his men.
stages.whoA: The strongman who cuts a deal, then beats him
stages.whoB: The loan shark Antoine owes

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica mocks Sirkes as a would-be Carl Icahn while Luke strikes a deal. At the warehouse she refuses to hand Antoine over and fights off his men.
stages.whoA: The investigator hired to find Antoine
stages.whoB: A loan shark she defies

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Dr. Hansen works under Malus at IGH as he treats Alisa. She worries about Alisa's rages and tries to sedate her, but Malus sends her out.
stages.whoA: The IGH scientist she works under
stages.whoB: A doctor on his IGH team

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Inez is a new nurse at IGH when her patient Alisa throws her into a glass cabinet and breaks her back. Alisa then kills Luanne, the other nurse.
stages.whoA: The IGH patient who broke her back
stages.whoB: A nurse she nearly killed at IGH

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Linda and Steven Benowitz scold Jeri over Pam's lawsuit, then learn of her ALS and push her to take a buyout. Jeri has Malcolm record Linda offering to launder a client's money and uses the tape to double her severance and leave with her clients.
stages.whoA: Her law partner, whom she forces out
stages.whoB: Her law partner, who turns on her

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Malcolm poses as a client named Millard Graves and meets Linda over martinis. She tells him Benowitz can move his client's dirty money overseas, and he hands the recording to Jeri.
stages.whoA: The fake client who records her for Jeri
stages.whoB: Jeri's partner he tricks on tape

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Louise and Albert ran experiments on their sick son Kevin, then fled when he made her burn her own face. Brought to his cell, she embraces him and then stabs him with scissors, and he makes her stab herself to death.
stages.whoA: Her son Kevin, who kills her
stages.whoB: His mother, who experimented on him

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica unmasks the quiet Betty in the victims' group as Kilgrave's mother, Louise. She tracks her down at home and Louise agrees to come and face her son, and Louise dies in the attempt.
stages.whoA: The investigator who unmasks her
stages.whoB: Kilgrave's mother, whom she brings to him

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Louise sits in on the victims' group Malcolm leads, listening without sharing. When Jessica presses her, Malcolm defends Betty, until Jessica reveals she is Kilgrave's mother.
stages.whoA: The leader of the group she sits in on
stages.whoB: Betty, a silent member of his group

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Manuel tells Jessica about his son Nathan's friendship with Sallinger and the gazebo built the day Nathan vanished. He begs Ronnie to let Jessica search, and Jessica digs Nathan's body out from under it.
stages.whoA: The investigator who finds his son
stages.whoB: Nathan's father, who backs her search

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Ana calls Ronnie to get Jessica out of the house, and the Silvas greet her with relief. Ronnie orders Manuel back inside for his safety as Jessica digs, and they see Nathan's body found together.
stages.whoA: The local officer who knows his family
stages.whoB: Nathan's father, a family friend

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Maury has never heard of Trish, but when she gets him a table at Saterre he lets her and Jessica into his morgue. She promises him the chef's table at Per Se for more tips.
stages.whoA: The radio host who books him tables
stages.whoB: The morgue attendant she bribes

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Now a fan of her show, Maury agrees to call Trish with the ID of an unidentified head in return for a table at Beirut. He calls with the ID: Dr. Leslie Hansen.
stages.whoA: The radio host who trades him favors
stages.whoB: Her inside man at the morgue

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica tries a fake identity and Trish's fame before a restaurant bribe gets Maury to open his morgue. He agrees to text her when an older man comes in, and later tips her about a body from the old CDC building.
stages.whoA: The investigator he tips about bodies
stages.whoB: The morgue attendant who tips her

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Jessica slips the unidentified head into Maury's morgue for him to log, and his call to Trish gives them a name: Dr. Leslie Hansen. It tells them someone else is posing as Hansen.
stages.whoA: The investigator who uses his tips
stages.whoB: The morgue attendant who tips her

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Trish confronts Max, who abused her when she was 15, and gives him 48 hours to help her or she goes public. When he calls her bluff she shows his star the tape of their talk, and Jessica forces him to make the call.
stages.whoA: The former child star he abused
stages.whoB: The director who abused her at 15

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Jessica finds Max on his set after he misses Trish's deadline. She pins him against his car, makes him repeat the letters IGH, and makes him call his contact.
stages.whoA: Trish's friend, who pins him to his car
stages.whoB: The director who abused Trish

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Malcolm secretly films Trish's threat to Max in his trailer, then confronts him himself. Max later sneers at Trish's thuggy boyfriend, his face bruised from a punch.
stages.whoA: The man who films and punches him
stages.whoB: The director who abused Trish

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Badly hurt, Simpson calls on Kozlov, who restarts his combat pills and welcomes him back into the program. When Simpson goes rogue with the pills, Kozlov sends men to bring him in.
stages.whoA: The soldier he puts back on combat pills
stages.whoB: The doctor behind his combat pills

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Trish rushes the wounded Simpson to Metro-General and leaves Kozlov messages. Kozlov takes over his care and orders her out of the room.
stages.whoA: Simpson's girlfriend, whom he sends away
stages.whoB: The doctor who takes Simpson from her

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Pam is Jeri's secretary and lover, waiting for her divorce from Wendy, and Jeri offers her a ring. Pam kills Wendy to save Jeri, then learns Jeri brought Kilgrave into it and tells the police Jeri is not her lawyer.
stages.whoA: Her boss and lover, whom she leaves
stages.whoB: Her secretary and lover, who leaves her

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica keeps pushing past Pam to reach Jeri. After Pam kills Wendy, Jessica tells her to say it was self defense and runs after Kilgrave.
stages.whoA: Jeri's investigator, who tells her to plead self defense
stages.whoB: Jeri's secretary and lover

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Peter and Kith run a scholarship in their late daughter Zoey's name and have an open marriage. When his thefts from the fund come out, Kith turns him away, and he kills himself on video.
stages.whoA: His wife, who turns him away
stages.whoB: Her husband, who stole from Zoey's fund

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Peter meets Jeri at Zoey's benefit and admires her powered clients. After his thefts are exposed he accuses her of breaking up his marriage, and his suicide video blames her.
stages.whoA: Kith's old flame, who exposes him
stages.whoB: Kith's husband, whom she ruins

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Jessica refuses Pryce's buyout and throws him through a glass door when he taunts her about Kilgrave. He tries to sue her, has Nick rob her and shoots at Alisa, and after Jessica takes him captive they agree to call it even.
stages.whoA: The rival investigator he wants to destroy
stages.whoB: The rival investigator who hounds her

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Pryce hires Jeri to sue Jessica, and she drops the suit. Later Jeri calls him in and puts him on a generous retainer for a job Jessica would object to.
stages.whoA: The lawyer who drops him, then hires him
stages.whoB: The investigator she puts on retainer

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Pryce mocks Malcolm as a wannabe do-gooder and offers him a job at Cheng Consulting for intel on Jessica. In the end Jeri brings them both into her new firm's first job.
stages.whoA: Jessica's helper he tries to poach
stages.whoB: The rival investigator who tries to poach him

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Learning that Alisa killed his friend Nick, Pryce shoots at her from across the street and hits Jessica instead. Alisa hunts him down, and Jessica has to hold her off while Pryce escapes.
stages.whoA: The woman who killed his friend
stages.whoB: The investigator who tries to shoot her

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Trish stakes out Reid, who got off a rape charge thanks to rich parents. When he drugs Birdie and drags her into an alley, Trish beats him and leaves him for the police.
stages.whoA: The masked woman who beats him
stages.whoB: The rapist she stops

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Jessica confronts Reyna about the blackmail note she paid. Reyna admits only to taking petty cash, so Jessica roughs her up and tells her staff she stole millions from their pensions.
stages.whoA: The investigator who exposes her
stages.whoB: The embezzler she exposes

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Erik, who has been blackmailing Reyna, brings Jessica to her. He senses she is hiding worse than the petty cash she admits, and Jessica forces it out of her.
stages.whoA: The blackmailer she paid
stages.whoB: One of his blackmail marks

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Robyn bosses her twin brother Ruben around their flat above Jessica and warns him off her. When he vanishes she searches for him, and after learning he is dead she lets him go at the river.
stages.whoA: Her twin brother
stages.whoB: His twin sister

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica lifts Robyn off the floor to quiet her. Robyn blames her for Ruben's disappearance, learns he died in her flat, and leads an attack that knocks Jessica out and frees Kilgrave, before Jessica saves her from his nooses.
stages.whoA: The neighbor she blames for Ruben
stages.whoB: Her loud upstairs neighbor

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Robyn catches Malcolm sneaking out of Jessica's flat and enlists him to make flyers for Ruben. She hears him confess at the victims' group, and afterwards he takes her to where he left Ruben's body.
stages.whoA: The neighbor who helps her look for Ruben
stages.whoB: Ruben's sister, whom he helps grieve

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Robyn frees the bound man in Jessica's flat, who turns out to be Kilgrave. He takes control of her and the victims and stands them on a bar with nooses as hostages.
stages.whoA: The man she frees, who takes control of her
stages.whoB: A hostage he puts in a noose

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Ronnie catches Jessica's lie about the tractor company and refuses her the Sallinger report, telling her she is the bigger threat. Jessica steals the file, digs at the Silvas' at gunpoint and finds Nathan, and Ronnie asks for her files back.
stages.whoA: The powered investigator she tries to stop
stages.whoB: The officer who stands in her way

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Trish fakes a panic over a car alarm to draw Ronnie out of the station while Jessica takes the file. At the Silvas', Trish films Ronnie holding Jessica at gunpoint.
stages.whoA: The woman who fools her and films her
stages.whoB: The officer she distracts

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Roy tends bar for Luke and minds the place while Luke goes away. After Luke's bar is blown up, Luke has to tell Roy his job is gone.
stages.whoA: His boss at the bar
stages.whoB: His bartender

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica comes to Luke's bar looking for him and finds Roy restocking. He tells her to move on, and she leaves him a message for Luke.
stages.whoA: A customer looking for Luke
stages.whoB: Luke's bartender, who takes her message

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Ruben thanks Jessica for calming his sister, brings her banana bread and asks her to the movies. Kilgrave makes him kill himself in her bed, and Jessica finds him there.
stages.whoA: The neighbor he loves
stages.whoB: Her sweet upstairs neighbor

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Ruben helps the stoned Malcolm down the stairs after he wanders into the twins' flat. After Ruben's death, Malcolm cleans up and dumps his body in the river.
stages.whoA: The neighbor he helps home
stages.whoB: The neighbor whose body he hides

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Ruben knocks on Jessica's door with banana bread and finds Kilgrave waiting in the dark. When Ruben says he loves her, Kilgrave makes him slit his own throat in her bed.
stages.whoA: The man who makes him kill himself
stages.whoB: The neighbor he makes kill himself

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Sunday and Costa work the Coleman and Spanos killings together, with Costa more willing to trust Jessica. Alisa takes Sunday in a headlock while Costa looks for a clear shot, and drags her out the window.
stages.whoA: Her partner
stages.whoB: His partner, killed by Alisa

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Sunday questions Jessica about Coleman's death and arrests her at gunpoint for Spanos's. She never believes her, but follows her lead to the hospital, where she dies trying to arrest Alisa.
stages.whoA: The powered suspect she never trusts
stages.whoB: The detective who suspects her

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Sunday hunts the powered killer of Coleman and Spanos. At the hospital she shoots Alisa in the leg, and Alisa seizes her and throws herself out the window with her.
stages.whoA: The killer she hunts, who kills her
stages.whoB: The detective she kills

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Trish shoves Sunday aside when she arrests Jessica. Later Sunday races to the hospital to protect Trish from Alisa and dies there.
stages.whoA: The woman she dies protecting
stages.whoB: The detective who comes to protect her

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Erik borrows from Sal and keeps paying late, so she has him weighted and dropped in her pool. Three hours late again, he is thrown back in until the masked vigilante attacks.
stages.whoA: A gambler who always pays late
stages.whoB: His bookie, who drowns late payers

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Masked, Trish storms Sal's house to pull Erik out of the pool. Sal swings a crowbar at her and ends up impaled on it, and Trish apologizes as she flees.
stages.whoA: The masked vigilante who crashed her house
stages.whoB: A bookie impaled during a rescue

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Serena asks Luke to find her missing brother Antoine in exchange for the file on the crash that killed Reva. When Antoine is home, she hands Luke the name Charles Wallace.
stages.whoA: Found her brother in exchange for the bus file
stages.whoB: Traded him the name of Reva's bus driver

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica brings Antoine home to Serena and demands what she promised Luke. Once Luke leaves with the driver's name, Jessica tells Serena he is going to kill that man.
stages.whoA: The P.I. who brought her brother home
stages.whoB: Antoine's sister, Luke's client

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Cellmates Sissy and Hope watch their prison TV show together. Hope pays Sissy fifty bucks and a pack of smokes to beat her, and Sissy nearly kills her.
stages.whoA: Her cellmate, who paid for a beating
stages.whoB: Her cellmate, paid to beat her

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica visits Sissy in prison after Hope's beating and slams her into a vending machine. Sissy admits she only did what Hope paid her to do.
stages.whoA: The visitor who slammed her into a machine
stages.whoB: Hope's cellmate and attacker

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Sonia and her ex-husband Oscar fight over custody of their son Vido. When she leaves with Vido and suitcases, Oscar tracks her to the bus station with Jessica.
stages.whoA: Her ex-husband, Vido's father
stages.whoB: His ex-wife, Vido's mother

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Sonia drags Vido home after finding him hanging from Jessica's window. Later she takes him onto a bus to Montreal, then agrees to stay.
stages.whoA: Her son
stages.whoB: His mother

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Sonia distrusts Jessica after seeing Vido dangling from her window. Jessica helps Oscar track Sonia to the bus station and stop her leaving with Vido.
stages.whoA: The neighbor she doesn't trust near Vido
stages.whoB: Vido's mother

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Benowitz and Chao use Jeri's scandal and her illness to push her out of the firm. Jeri digs for dirt and uses a tape of Chao laundering money to double her severance, promising not to out Steven.
stages.whoA: His name partner, pushed out of the firm
stages.whoB: A name partner pushing her out

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Benowitz delivers client transfer papers to Jeri's new firm in person, taking Rand Enterprises. He thanks her for telling him to come out and urges her to slow down.
stages.whoA: His old partner, now a rival firm
stages.whoB: Her old partner, poaching her clients

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Malcolm finds Benowitz at a Chelsea bar and, instead of blackmailing him, tells him to go home and tell his wife the truth. Jeri later reveals Malcolm was working for her.
stages.whoA: Jeri's investigator who trailed him
stages.whoB: Jeri's partner he trailed to a bar

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Stirling meets Jessica at his bar, quits with a bottle of whiskey, and they start dating. He agrees to lend her muscle to Wyatt, and she finds him dead in an alley.
stages.whoA: His girlfriend
stages.whoB: Her boyfriend, who dreamed of Club Alias

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Wyatt invested in Stirling's Club Alias and comes for his money until Jessica beats him and his men. He then offers to forgive the debt for Jessica as muscle, and Stirling agrees for a cut.
stages.whoA: The investor demanding his money back
stages.whoB: The bartender who owes him

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Alisa overhears Stirling selling Jessica's muscle to Wyatt and confronts him outside. Calling herself Jessica's mother, she beats him to death against a wall.
stages.whoA: Jessica's mother, his killer
stages.whoB: Jessica's boyfriend, whom she killed

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Wyatt shoves Stirling around over his debt until Jessica throws him and his men out. Wanting her strength for his jobs, he cuts a deal with Stirling, but the cops arrest him after Stirling's death.
stages.whoA: Stirling's girlfriend, who beat his crew
stages.whoB: Stirling's investor, who wanted her as muscle

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Jessica and Erik pose as couriers to ask Todd why he paid a blackmail note. She finds his photos of young girls, locks him in a closet and calls the police.
stages.whoA: The P.I. who exposed him
stages.whoB: A blackmail mark, exposed as a predator

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Todd is the first mark on Erik's blackmail list, and he paid. Erik comes to his door with Jessica to learn whether Todd tried to kill him.
stages.whoA: The blackmailer who targeted him
stages.whoB: Mark number one on his list

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Wendy learns of Jeri's affair with Pam and fights the divorce for 70% of everything. Enthralled by Kilgrave, she tries to kill Jeri with a thousand cuts until Pam strikes her dead.
stages.whoA: Her wife, divorcing her for Pam
stages.whoB: Her wife, killed by Pam

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jeri brings a wounded Kilgrave to Wendy's home, and he orders her to treat him. Before fleeing, he tells her to kill Jeri with a thousand cuts.
stages.whoA: The man who took over her mind
stages.whoB: Jeri's wife, ordered to kill her

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
