stages.text: Jessica asks Wendy for Sufentanil and gets an anti-psychotic prescription instead. Later, for Jeri, she dangles Wendy over the subway tracks to make her sign the divorce papers.
stages.whoA: Jeri's P.I., who threatened her
stages.whoB: Jeri's wife, a doctor

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Whizzer begs Jessica to protect him from something hunting him, and she brushes him off. When he pulls a gun and flees at super speed, she chases him and finds him dead under scaffolding.
stages.whoA: The P.I. he begged for protection
stages.whoB: A speedster who begged for her help

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Something strong and fast hunts Whizzer through the city. Alisa catches up with him and brings scaffolding down on him.
stages.whoA: The killer who hunted him
stages.whoB: A speedster she killed

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Zaya and Malcolm date and work together at Hogarth & Associates. She edits the footage of him letting the masked vigilante go, but he pulls away, and she leaves when she finds Brianna at his place.
stages.whoA: Her boyfriend and fellow associate
stages.whoB: His girlfriend, a lawyer at Jeri's firm

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Zaya works under Jeri and calls her the best mentor. Jeri sets her on the masked vigilante's trail, and Zaya edits the security footage to hide Malcolm's part.
stages.whoA: Her boss and mentor
stages.whoB: A lawyer at her firm

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: B-15 tells the judges' council that everyone at the TVA is a Variant, and Gamble backs her by ordering all pruning stopped. Later B-15 asks Gamble what to do with Dox and her loyalists, and Gamble tells her to win Dox over.
stages.whoA: The hunter whose words changed her mind
stages.whoB: The judge who heeds her and stops pruning

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Gamble and Dox sit together on the new judges' council. When Dox insists the timeline must not branch, Gamble sides with B-15 and stops the pruning instead.
stages.whoA: Her fellow leader on the judges' council
stages.whoB: The judge who overrules her on pruning

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Mobius comes before the judges' council with B-15 and plays Loki's recording about the TVA. Gamble hears him out before ordering the pruning stopped.
stages.whoA: The agent who testifies before her council
stages.whoB: The judge who hears his testimony

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: D-90 testifies to Gamble's council that he saw Renslayer's Variant on the timeline. Later he escorts B-15 to Gamble and waits while they talk.
stages.whoA: The judge who hears his testimony
stages.whoB: The hunter whose testimony backs B-15

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: D-90 searches the Roxxcart shelter with Mobius and finds C-20. Later, on Renslayer's order, D-90 prunes Mobius with his time stick.
stages.whoA: The agent he hunts with, then prunes
stages.whoB: The hunter who prunes him on orders

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: D-90 apologizes to Mobius for pruning him, and Mobius says Renslayer owes him the real apology. They work together again, and D-90 offers to take Victor Timely off Mobius's hands.
stages.whoA: The agent he apologizes to and works with
stages.whoB: The hunter who says sorry for pruning him

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: B-15 leads D-90 on the hunt for the Variant. When they meet again at a school, she tells him to stand down and shows him Renslayer's double, proof that they are all Variants.
stages.whoA: The hunter who leads him and shows him the truth
stages.whoB: A hunter on her team

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: D-90 warns B-15 that Dox is raiding the armory, and they bring in X-5 and Dox's loyalists together. He stands with her when she asks Dox to help the new TVA, then she sends him to help Mobius.
stages.whoA: The hunter he follows in the new TVA
stages.whoB: Her loyal hunter

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Renslayer orders D-90 to prune Mobius, and he does. She calls him in again when Sylvie hides in the courtroom, and he watches Sylvie prune herself.
stages.whoA: The judge whose orders he follows
stages.whoB: The hunter who prunes Mobius for her

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: D-90 joins the mission that brings Loki along to hunt the Variant. When Loki slips away at Roxxcart, D-90 tells Mobius his favorite Loki has betrayed him.
stages.whoA: The Variant he hunts alongside
stages.whoB: A hunter on the Roxxcart mission

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: D-90 helps haul X-5 into holding as one of Dox's men. Later X-5 prunes D-90 and takes Victor Timely.
stages.whoA: Dox's hunter, who prunes him
stages.whoB: The hunter who locks him up, then gets pruned

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: D-90 warns that Dox is raiding the armory and later takes her into custody with her loyalists. He stands guard when B-15 visits her in holding.
stages.whoA: The general he arrests
stages.whoB: A hunter who arrests her

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: D-90 offers to take Timely to the hot cocoa machine, and the two quietly share a cup. Then D-90 is pruned and Timely is taken.
stages.whoA: The professor he guards over hot cocoa
stages.whoB: The hunter who shares cocoa with him

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Renslayer reports to the Time-Keepers and brings Loki and Sylvie before them to be pruned. She fights to protect them, until Sylvie shows they are only androids.
stages.whoA: The judge who serves them
stages.whoB: The rulers she serves

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Sylvie is brought before the Time-Keepers, the rulers she has hunted, and they order her deleted. She beheads one and finds they are mindless androids.
stages.whoA: The Variant who exposes them
stages.whoB: The fake rulers she unmasks

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Loki is brought before the Time-Keepers with Sylvie, and they call him a cosmic disappointment and order both deleted. Loki fights beside Sylvie and sees them revealed as androids.
stages.whoA: The Variant they sentence
stages.whoB: The rulers who sentence him

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: B-15 breaks into the Time-Keepers' chamber and hands Loki and Sylvie their weapons. That lets Sylvie reach and unmask the androids.
stages.whoA: The hunter who turns on them
stages.whoB: The rulers she turns against

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Aisha storms into the barbershop and tells Luke to stop standing by while Zip robs Harlem. Luke gets her father's ring back and makes her take her hand off the gun at Pop's funeral.
stages.whoA: The hero who gets her father's ring back
stages.whoB: A shop owner who pushes him to fight

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Aisha tells Luke what the Bushmaster drug did at a party she threw. She tells him he needs to handle it.
stages.whoA: The hero she asks for help
stages.whoB: A friend who warns him about the drug

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Zip wrecks Aisha's shop and takes her father's championship ring, telling her to complain to Luke Cage.
stages.whoA: The thug who steals her father's ring
stages.whoB: A shop owner he robs

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Bobby talks with Aisha about her father Eddie when she comes to the barbershop for help. Later he tells Luke that Aisha is tougher than she looks.
stages.whoA: A barbershop regular who knows her family
stages.whoB: A tough neighbor he looks out for

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Rackham singles out the new inmate Carl and forces him into his fight club by threatening Squabbles and Reva. When Carl tries to expose him, Rackham overloads Burstein's tank to kill him and dies in the blast.
stages.whoA: The inmate he forces to fight
stages.whoB: The Seagate guard who forced him to fight

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Rackham uses Shades and Comanche to break Carl and recruit fighters. He sends them to beat Carl nearly to death when Carl plans to expose the fights.
stages.whoA: An inmate who does his dirty work
stages.whoB: The guard he works for at Seagate

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Rackham pulls Carl away from Reva and later threatens to hurt her to keep him fighting. Carl warns Reva to get away from him.
stages.whoA: The psychologist he threatens
stages.whoB: The guard who threatens her

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Alex handles Mariah's press and suggests she paint Cottonmouth as a brave man killed by a freak. He tracks Candace for her and picks her up after Misty has to let her go.
stages.whoA: The councilwoman he serves
stages.whoB: Her loyal aide

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Alex runs Mariah's events and her security as she takes over the family business, and she flirts with him as her one loyal man. He attends her trial, then is killed as she silences everyone who worked for her.
stages.whoA: The boss who has him killed
stages.whoB: Her loyal aide

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Shades has Alex bring Mariah clean clothes after Cottonmouth dies. Together they pick Mariah up from the precinct after Candace is killed.
stages.whoA: Mariah's right hand
stages.whoB: Mariah's aide

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Alex and Shades both serve Mariah at Harlem's Paradise. When Shades finds Mariah getting close to Alex, he orders Alex out.
stages.whoA: Mariah's jealous right hand
stages.whoB: Mariah's aide, his rival for her trust

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Alex introduces himself to Tilda as her mother's assistant and looks after her for Mariah. At the end he begs Tilda to tell Mariah he would never rat, and she sends him away.
stages.whoA: Mariah's daughter, who cannot save him
stages.whoB: Her mother's assistant

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Anansi carried young John to safety after he was shot and saved him with nightshade. Now he begs his nephew to drop his war on the Stokes and refuses to make him more nightshade.
stages.whoA: The nephew he saved and cannot stop
stages.whoB: His uncle, who saved his life

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Mariah has Anansi brought to her and taunts him, and he tells her she deserves what Bushmaster brings. At Gwen's she has him doused in rum and set on fire.
stages.whoA: The woman who burns him alive
stages.whoB: Bushmaster's uncle, whom she kills

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Shades grabs Anansi on his way to Gwen's and locks him in a car trunk for Mariah. He is there when Mariah's crew kills everyone at Gwen's.
stages.whoA: The man who kidnaps him
stages.whoB: Bushmaster's uncle, whom he kidnaps

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Arturo draws a gun on Luke at Harlem's Paradise and later blows up a truck with Luke inside. He shoots Luke with a Judas bullet that does nothing, and Luke knocks him out for Misty.
stages.whoA: The hero he tries to kill
stages.whoB: The drug lord who shoots him

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Shades and Comanche come to collect Mariah's money after Arturo's release. Arturo threatens to talk to Misty and insults Mariah, and Shades kills him.
stages.whoA: The man who kills him
stages.whoB: A buyer he kills for insulting Mariah

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Arturo pitches for Mariah's guns, and she picks him as her buyer. She sends him a Judas rifle up front.
stages.whoA: The woman who sells him her guns
stages.whoB: The buyer she chooses for her guns

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Misty questions Arturo after Luke brings him in and offers him a deal against Mariah. He mocks her arm and walks free when Donovan arrives.
stages.whoA: The detective who questions him
stages.whoB: The dealer she cannot hold

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Donovan arrives at the precinct and argues that Luke's arrest of Arturo will not hold. He gets Arturo out on bail paid by Mariah.
stages.whoA: The lawyer who gets him out
stages.whoB: A client he springs for the Stokes

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: After dropping Mariah, Donovan goes to work for Bushmaster at Harlem's Paradise. He stops Misty's search when it turns into harassment of his client.
stages.whoA: His new client after Mariah
stages.whoB: His lawyer

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Donovan tells Shades to keep quiet during Misty's questioning. Later he tells Shades and Mariah that her money and club are back.
stages.whoA: Mariah's right hand
stages.whoB: The family's lawyer

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Donovan and Foggy meet across the table over Cockroach's claim against Luke. Donovan names his price and gives them 72 hours.
stages.whoA: Luke's lawyer across the table
stages.whoB: Cockroach's lawyer

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Pop looks after Chico and asks Luke to bring him home safe after the robbery. Pop is killed when Tone shoots up the barbershop to get Chico.
stages.whoA: The barber who looks out for him
stages.whoB: A young man he tries to save

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Luke tracks Chico down after the robbery and talks him into coming back to Pop's. He tries to buy Chico's safety from Cottonmouth.
stages.whoA: The man who brings him home
stages.whoB: The barber he tries to protect

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Tone opens fire on Pop's Barber Shop to kill Chico. Chico survives badly wounded, but Pop dies.
stages.whoA: The gunman who shoots up the shop
stages.whoB: The robber he tries to kill

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Chico calls Scarfe to testify against Cottonmouth. Scarfe, secretly on Cottonmouth's payroll, strangles him and brings the body to Cottonmouth.
stages.whoA: The detective who kills him
stages.whoB: The witness he murders

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Luke bursts in on Cockroach's gambling party, then stops him from beating Drea and throws him around his apartment. Cockroach sues Luke and lies to his face across the table.
stages.whoA: The hero who beats him and gets sued
stages.whoB: The abuser who sues him

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Misty once arrested Cockroach with Scarfe, and she confronts him after his release. She catches him faking his injuries and tells him to drop the suit.
stages.whoA: The detective who wants him locked up
stages.whoB: The abuser she cannot pin down

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Bushmaster finds Cockroach at home and cuts off his head. He puts it on a spike at Mariah's grand opening.
stages.whoA: The man who beheads him
stages.whoB: A gangster he kills to hit Mariah

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Scarfe searches Cockroach's apartment and claims to find a gun on the headboard. Cockroach swears it was planted, and the conviction is thrown out once Scarfe is exposed.
stages.whoA: The dirty cop who framed him
stages.whoB: A man he sends to prison

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Cockroach hires Donovan to sue Luke after the beating. Donovan has the lights dimmed for his client and coaches his story.
stages.whoA: His lawyer in the suit against Luke
stages.whoB: The client he represents against Luke

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Dunbar witnesses Shades's proffer and warns that any lie voids the deal. He presses Shades about Candace Miller.
stages.whoA: The witness whose deal he oversees
stages.whoB: The federal prosecutor at his proffer

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Misty names Dunbar for the record as they take Shades's statement together. The proffer gives them their case against Mariah.
stages.whoA: The detective building the case with him
stages.whoB: The federal prosecutor on her case

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Dunbar works with Tower on the prosecution of Mariah. Tower presses the charges in court.
stages.whoA: The prosecutor he works with
stages.whoB: A federal prosecutor on the case

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Boone, who has spent years trying to take Mariah's seat, urges her to step aside as the scandal grows. At her rally he tells her he knows Luke is not the killer.
stages.whoA: The councilwoman he wants to replace
stages.whoB: Her longtime political rival

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Diamondback takes Boone hostage at Harlem's Paradise and makes him tell the police that Luke is behind it. Then he tells Boone his life story and kills him with a gauntlet.
stages.whoA: The man who takes him hostage and kills him
stages.whoB: A hostage he uses and kills

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Dana is the preacher's secretary and his lover, and Willis is their son. James pays to keep the secret, and the checks stop if she tells.
stages.whoA: The preacher she loves, who hides their son
stages.whoB: His secretary and secret lover

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Dana is Willis's mother, and Luke learns that she is why Willis is his brother. Willis tells Boone she died of cancer alone in a shelter, still wanting him to have something of his father's.
stages.whoA: Her son Willis
stages.whoB: His mother

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Dante helps rob the Stokes gun deal at the junkyard while skipping his shift at Cottonmouth's club. Shot by Shameek and dying, he phones Tone and gives up Shameek and Chico.
stages.whoA: The Stokes enforcer he called with the robbers' names
stages.whoB: The dying bartender who named the junkyard robbers

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Dorsey drags Lonnie in off the street and demands to know where Luke is. When Lonnie calls him a liar and gets up to leave, Dorsey beats him bloody until other officers pull him off.
stages.whoA: The kid he beat in an interrogation room
stages.whoB: The detective who beat him over Luke

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Ridley runs the precinct as her officers hunt for Luke after Albini's death. After Dorsey beats Lonnie, she has him arrested and suspended without pay.
stages.whoA: The inspector who suspended him
stages.whoB: The detective she suspended for beating Lonnie

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Both men are 29th Precinct officers furious over Albini's murder. Dorsey tries to calm Smith down when he loses his temper in the squad room.
stages.whoA: A fellow officer he tried to calm down
stages.whoB: The detective who tried to calm him

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Luke comes to Drea's door looking for Cockroach, and she sends her son to his room and shuts him out. When Cockroach beats her for it, a neighbor calls Luke, who stops him.
stages.whoA: The man who stopped Cockroach beating her
stages.whoB: Cockroach's girlfriend, who would not give him up

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Misty visits Drea after Cockroach hits her again and pushes her to press charges. Drea says Misty already put him away once and she is too scared of him to talk.
stages.whoA: The detective who begged her to press charges
stages.whoB: Cockroach's girlfriend, too scared to talk

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Luke remembers his mother Etta taking young Carl to practice after a fight with his father at the church. He also sees her threaten Dana Stryker into keeping quiet about Willis.
stages.whoA: Her son Carl
stages.whoB: His mother

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: At Seagate, Etta, already sick, believes Carl when he swears he is innocent. Luke later tells his father she never gave up on him.
stages.whoA: Her son, framed and in Seagate
stages.whoB: His mother, who never gave up on him

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Etta begs her husband James to be there for Carl instead of only his congregation. She knows about his affair with Dana and pays to keep it quiet.
stages.whoA: Her husband, the reverend
stages.whoB: His wife Etta

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Etta and James visit Carl at Seagate together. James refuses to hear his son out while Etta keeps believing him.
stages.whoA: Her husband, who would not believe Carl
stages.whoB: His wife, who stood by Carl

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Misty visits Gideon at an ICE facility because he owns the warehouse tied to Bushmaster. He tells her he grew up with John McIver and warns that Bushmaster has come to take back everything with fire.
stages.whoA: The detective who questioned him at ICE
stages.whoB: Bushmaster's friend, held by ICE

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: After Albini's murder, Smith presses Ridley to hit the streets hard and smoke Luke out. Ridley tells him to watch his tone and remember he serves Harlem.
stages.whoA: The inspector who reined him in
stages.whoB: The officer pushing to smoke Luke out

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Smith leads officers into Pop's to look for Luke and holds Bobby at gunpoint. They talk chess while the search comes up empty, and he warns there will be hell to pay if Bobby is hiding him.
stages.whoA: The barber he held at gunpoint
stages.whoB: The cop who searched Pop's at gunpoint

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Cottonmouth pays for Pop's funeral at Spurlock's and asks Joel for the room. Later he hands Spurlock cash and tells him Tone's body cannot exist.
stages.whoA: The client who pays him to lose bodies
stages.whoB: The undertaker who makes bodies disappear

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Luke comes to Spurlock's to plan Pop's funeral and finds the mahogany and gold casket too much. Spurlock offers cheaper options before Cottonmouth steps in to pay.
stages.whoA: The man arranging Pop's funeral
stages.whoB: The undertaker handling Pop's funeral

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Spurlock asks Tilda whether Mariah should get the usual mahogany and gold. She tells him to just cremate her and corrects him that her name is Tilda Johnson.
stages.whoA: The daughter who had Mariah cremated
stages.whoB: The undertaker who handled Mariah

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Koko is with Zip's crew when they shake down Genghis Connie's and Luke steps in. He fires point blank, the bullet stops on Luke's skin, and Luke knocks him down.
stages.whoA: The bulletproof man he shot at
stages.whoB: One of Zip's crew at Genghis Connie's

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: At Cottonmouth's state of the union, Koko raises his hand to say they should leave Luke his side of the street. Cottonmouth shoots him dead on the spot.
stages.whoA: The boss who shot him for speaking up
stages.whoB: The crew member he killed for backing off Luke

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Koko rides with Zip's crew pushing the Lins for money for Mariah. Both are beaten by Luke when they try to fight him.
stages.whoA: The crew leader he ran with
stages.whoB: One of his crew at Genghis Connie's

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Koko mocks the Lins' English while Zip's crew demands money at Genghis Connie's. Luke throws the crew out of Connie's restaurant.
stages.whoA: The restaurant owner his crew tried to shake down
stages.whoB: One of the thugs who threatened her restaurant

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Lonnie sits in Pop's chair when Tone opens fire, and Luke throws himself in front of him and tells him to play dead. Later Lonnie insists Luke is a good dude who would never kill a cop, and cheers him on against Diamondback.
stages.whoA: The man who covered him in the shooting
stages.whoB: The kid he shielded at Pop's

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: When strangers ask Lonnie where to find Luke, he says Luke just shows up and points them to the barbershop.
stages.whoA: The hero he says always shows up
stages.whoB: A kid from Pop's

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Lonnie gets his hair cut by Pop, who apologizes for cursing in front of him. Pop is cutting his hair again on the night of the shooting.
stages.whoA: His barber
stages.whoB: A young regular in his chair

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Young Cornell stays at a Jamaican resort while Mama Mabel meets Gwen McIver over the McIvers' claim. She and Pistol Pete laugh at Gwen's demands.
stages.whoA: Her grandson Cornell
stages.whoB: His grandmother

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Mama Mabel tells Cornell to keep his music down and get dirt on him instead. She has him take out a drug dealer, then hands him a gun and orders him to shoot Pistol Pete.
stages.whoA: Her grandson, raised to kill for her
stages.whoB: The grandmother who made him a killer

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Young Mariah is at the resort in Jamaica as Mama Mabel feuds with Gwen McIver. That feud starts everything Bushmaster comes for.
stages.whoA: Her granddaughter Mariah
stages.whoB: Her grandmother

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Mama Mabel sends Mariah upstairs to study and wants her out of the business. Mariah joins her and Cornell when Pistol Pete is shot.
stages.whoA: Her granddaughter, kept out of the business
stages.whoB: The grandmother she grew up under

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Young Pop brings Mama Mabel cash and a stolen watch as tribute and asks to take Cornell out. She sends him away and turns on the man who came with him.
stages.whoA: A young hustler who paid her tribute
stages.whoB: The crime boss he paid tribute to

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Mama Mabel throws a firebomb into the McIver home and watches Gwen burn. She finds young John outside and tells him his mother should not have brought lawyers.
stages.whoA: Gwen McIver's son, who escaped the fire
stages.whoB: The woman who burned his mother alive

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Mario wants to take his ESU team into Harlem's Paradise and Ridley tells him to stand down until there is a plan. He pushes until she lets him go in.
stages.whoA: The inspector he pushed to let him storm the club
stages.whoB: The ESU lieutenant itching to go in

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Mario's team arrests Luke at Harlem's Paradise and escorts him with Judas bullets. When Luke escapes the convoy, Mario orders fire at will, and later aims at him again until he is told to stand down.
stages.whoA: The fugitive his team was ordered to stop
stages.whoB: The ESU lieutenant who ordered fire on him

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: After the hostage siege, Misty asks Mario for a minute with Luke before transport. Mario tells her his men will be right there and gives her the time.
stages.whoA: The detective who asked for a word with Luke
stages.whoB: The ESU lieutenant on Luke's transport

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Bailey jokes with Misty at the junkyard scene and helps her dig into Luke. He traces Luke's call, then brings her the news that Candace Miller has been killed and holds her back from Mariah.
stages.whoA: His fellow detective
stages.whoB: A detective at her precinct

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Bailey welcomes Misty back but sides with Nandi when they clash. He refuses to believe Nandi sold out Mariah until Misty shows him the proof, and then he arrests Nandi himself.
stages.whoA: The friend who proved Nandi dirty
stages.whoB: The friend who arrested his own partner

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Ridley has Bailey and Misty look into who Luke really is. Bailey finds almost nothing on him and wonders who made him.
stages.whoA: His inspector
stages.whoB: One of her detectives

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Ridley and Misty call Bailey into the interrogation room and lay out the key card record against Nandi. Ridley tells him to answer the question.
stages.whoA: His inspector
stages.whoB: The detective she questioned about Nandi

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Bailey questions Mariah about Mark Higgins going missing after her party. She says she barely talked to him that night.
stages.whoA: The councilwoman he questioned about Higgins
stages.whoB: A detective asking about Higgins

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Mariah shows Higgins photos of his affair and threatens to send them to his wife unless he votes for the Glenn Industries deal. He gives in, and soon after he goes missing.
stages.whoA: The woman who blackmailed him
stages.whoB: The CEO she blackmailed over the merger

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Megan interviews Councilwoman Dillard about the Crispus Attucks Complex, and Mariah tells her she is always welcome in Harlem. Later the press crowds Mariah over Cornell's arrest.
stages.whoA: The councilwoman she interviewed
stages.whoB: The reporter covering her Harlem plans

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Nandi has Misty's old desk at the 29th Precinct and refuses to give it back, and the two old teammates snipe at each other on every case. When Nandi sells Mariah out to Bushmaster, Misty chases her down at the airport and confronts her in interrogation.
stages.whoA: Her old high school rival who won't let her work
stages.whoB: The detective who took her desk, then sold out Mariah

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Ridenhour runs the precinct and hands Nandi and Bailey cases like Arturo Rey's murder. After he is shot, Nandi works the scene.
stages.whoA: Her precinct captain
stages.whoB: A detective under his command

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Ridley takes charge of the precinct after Ridenhour's death. Nandi eavesdrops on her talk with Misty about Mariah's immunity deal and uses it to sell Mariah out, and Ridley's people bring her in.
stages.whoA: The chief running her precinct
stages.whoB: A detective who betrays the department

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Nandi visits Bushmaster at Harlem's Paradise with Misty, then goes back alone. She asks if his bounty is still good and gives him Mariah's location for the cash.
stages.whoA: The man who pays her to give up Mariah
stages.whoB: The cop who sells him Mariah's hideout

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Nandi questions Mariah about Mark Higgins and hunts for proof tying her to Ridenhour's death. Convinced Mariah should not win, Nandi sells her location to Bushmaster.
stages.whoA: The crime boss she sells out
stages.whoB: A detective who sells her to Bushmaster

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Neville sits at the table when Diamondback walks into Mariah's meeting at Colon's gym. Neville tells him to ease up, but Diamondback shoots him and another boss with a single bullet.
stages.whoA: The arms dealer who shoots him
stages.whoB: A Yardies boss he kills at Colon's gym

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Mariah calls Harlem's crime bosses, Neville among them, to Colon's gym to sell off Cottonmouth's business. The meeting ends when Diamondback kills Neville and the others.
stages.whoA: The councilwoman who calls the bosses together
stages.whoB: A rival boss at her Colon's gym meeting

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Domingo gathers the bosses for Mariah, naming Neville with the Yardies among those invited. Diamondback spares Domingo but kills Neville at the table.
stages.whoA: A rival boss who sets up the meeting
stages.whoB: The Yardies boss he invites to the table

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: At Seagate, Dr. Burstein puts a dying Carl Lucas in his experimental bath, and the blast leaves him unbreakable. Years later Luke and Claire bring him the Judas shrapnel, and Burstein repeats the bath to save him, but Luke smashes his lab when Burstein keeps calling him Carl.
stages.whoA: The doctor whose experiment made him
stages.whoB: The test subject he made unbreakable

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Claire brings a dying Luke to Burstein and helps him recreate the Seagate bath. When Luke's heart stops, Claire shocks him back to life as Burstein watches.
stages.whoA: The nurse who helps him save Luke
stages.whoB: The scientist she helps save Luke

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Reva works with Dr. Burstein at Seagate and brings him the beaten Carl Lucas, begging him to save his life. Her stolen hard drive later gives Burstein back all his lost research.
stages.whoA: The Seagate counselor who worked beside him
stages.whoB: The prison doctor she brings Carl to

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: After Luke beats Diamondback, Burstein comes to the guarded hospital room where he lies wounded. He smiles at the officer and shuts the door to talk with him alone.
stages.whoA: The wounded prisoner he visits
stages.whoB: The doctor who comes to see him

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Patty flirts with Luke at Pop's and leaves him her number, joking he may need a lawyer one day. When the shop is shot up, Luke shields her son Lonnie from the bullets.
stages.whoA: The barbershop sweeper she has her eye on
stages.whoB: Lonnie's mom, a flirt at Pop's

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Pop cuts Lonnie's hair and teases Patty as Counselor before she has passed the bar. He dies in the shooting at his shop while Lonnie is in the chair.
stages.whoA: Her son's barber and an old friend
stages.whoB: Lonnie's mother, the future lawyer

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: After police beat Lonnie in custody, Mariah marches into the precinct with Patricia. Mariah uses Lonnie's beating to rally Harlem against the police and Luke.
stages.whoA: The councilwoman who takes up her cause
stages.whoB: A furious mother she brings to the precinct

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: At the precinct Misty asks how Lonnie is, and Patricia tells her to keep her son's name out of her mouth.
stages.whoA: A detective she blames for her son's beating
stages.whoB: Lonnie's angry mother

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Misty takes Shades's confession with Patricia as his attorney. When Patricia learns of the barbershop shooting, she recuses herself and leaves Misty to finish.
stages.whoA: The detective taking her client's confession
stages.whoB: Shades's lawyer, until she walks out

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Patricia is assigned as Shades's attorney for his confession against Mariah. When he admits Cottonmouth's crew shot up Pop's, where her son nearly died, she drops him and tells him to burn in hell.
stages.whoA: The client she drops in disgust
stages.whoB: His lawyer, who quits on him

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Perez works the hunt for Scarfe beside Misty while secretly feeding Cottonmouth. Misty fakes a call from Scarfe, Perez blurts out his guilt, and she makes him cuff himself.
stages.whoA: The detective who tricks and arrests him
stages.whoB: The dirty lieutenant she exposes

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Perez is on Cottonmouth's payroll and arranges the stolen Hammer guns for him. While hunting Scarfe, he tells Cottonmouth about the van seen at Pop's.
stages.whoA: The crime boss who pays him
stages.whoB: His man inside the police

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Perez and Scarfe are both on Cottonmouth's payroll. Perez warns Scarfe that Internal Affairs is onto him and passes on Cottonmouth's order to move the guns, then hunts him once he runs.
stages.whoA: A fellow dirty cop
stages.whoB: The lieutenant who shares his secret

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Piranha has known Mariah since he was a kid and runs her money, steering her into the Atreus Plastics deal with power of attorney over her assets. Bushmaster forces him to move all of it out of her accounts.
stages.whoA: The client whose fortune he runs
stages.whoB: Her Wall Street money man

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Piranha, a huge fan, hires Luke to stand guard at his party. When the Stylers attack, Luke hides him in an old theater and at his father's church, but Bushmaster's men still take him.
stages.whoA: The hero he hires as his bodyguard
stages.whoB: A fan who hires him, then gets taken

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Bushmaster's men take Piranha and hold him while Bushmaster makes him type in the codes to Mariah's money. Then Bushmaster has him beheaded.
stages.whoA: The man who takes Mariah's money and his life
stages.whoB: Mariah's money man, made to drain her

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Shades sits in as Piranha pitches Mariah the Atreus Plastics deal. He is at Piranha's party when the Stylers attack.
stages.whoA: Mariah's right hand on the deal
stages.whoB: Mariah's Wall Street money man

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Foggy comes with Luke to Piranha's office and bargains Luke's fee up to $150,000 for one night as a bodyguard.
stages.whoA: Luke's lawyer, who sets the fee
stages.whoB: The fan paying Luke to guard him

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Sheldon calls on Luke to give up the little guppy and sends men all over Harlem after Piranha. They finally take him for Bushmaster.
stages.whoA: The Stylers man hunting him
stages.whoB: The money man he hunts

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Uncle Pete pays for young Cornell's piano lessons and wants him out of the life, but takes him along to kill Donnie. When Mabel learns Pete is dealing with the Colons, Cornell shoots him.
stages.whoA: The great-nephew who shoots him
stages.whoB: The uncle he loved, then killed

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Mariah tells Pete he deserves what is coming as Cornell holds him at gunpoint. Pete brushes off what he did to her as a game.
stages.whoA: The great-niece he abused
stages.whoB: The uncle she wanted dead

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Pete appears in Mariah's mind beside Mabel as she plans her revenge. He praises how he molded her and calls Tilda their daughter, and she orders him to keep Tilda's name out of his mouth.
stages.whoA: The great-niece he still haunts
stages.whoB: The uncle who haunts her

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: After the Stokes family burns Gwen McIver's home, Pete tracks her son John to a Jamaican market. He shoots the boy and leaves him for dead, saying it is for Buggy.
stages.whoA: The boy he shoots for Buggy
stages.whoB: The Stokes gunman who shot him as a boy

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Shameek robs Cottonmouth's gun sale at the junkyard. Tone brings him to Harlem's Paradise, he spits in Cottonmouth's face, and Cottonmouth beats him to death.
stages.whoA: The crime boss he robs
stages.whoB: The thief he beats to death

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Tone finds Shameek celebrating at a strip club and drags him to Cottonmouth, then gets rid of his body.
stages.whoA: The thug who hauls him in
stages.whoB: The robber he brings to Cottonmouth

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: At Pop's, Shameek needles Luke about sweeping floors, then backs down when Luke stares him down.
stages.whoA: The quiet sweeper he picks at
stages.whoB: A loudmouth at Pop's

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Shameek hangs out at Pop's while Chico cuts his hair, and Pop teases him about his basketball dreams. After his death, Pop works to keep Chico from ending up the same way.
stages.whoA: The barber who knows him well
stages.whoB: A loud regular at his shop

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Sheldon grew up with John in Jamaica and follows him to New York as his right hand. He films Luke's fights for Bushmaster to study, carries him to Tilda when he is dying, and sends him home to Jamaica.
stages.whoA: His childhood friend and the crew's leader
stages.whoB: His bredren and right hand

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Sheldon has his cousin Stephanie take a job at Harlem's Paradise to spy on Mariah, and tells her to hold on when she wants to quit. He weeps when he learns she was killed at Gwen's.
stages.whoA: His cousin, spying for him
stages.whoB: Her cousin, who sent her in

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Sheldon brings the dying Bushmaster to Tilda and warns her that if he dies, she dies. She heals him, turns on her mother, and Sheldon thanks her before he leaves.
stages.whoA: The doctor he forces to heal Bushmaster
stages.whoB: Bushmaster's man who first threatens her

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Sheldon tells Luke to release Piranha or face war, and his men take Piranha from him. Once Mariah is gone, Sheldon walks into Pop's to say Harlem is in the right hands now.
stages.whoA: The hero he fights, then respects
stages.whoB: Bushmaster's right hand

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Sheldon helps Bushmaster burn Mariah's brownstone and seize Harlem's Paradise, then joins the attack to drag her out of hiding. Mariah's men kill his cousin at Gwen's.
stages.whoA: The Stokes woman they want dead
stages.whoB: Bushmaster's right hand

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: At Seagate, Squabbles keeps reaching out to the silent Carl Lucas and stops him from killing Comanche. He coaches Carl in Rackham's fight ring and dies refusing to give him up.
stages.whoA: His friend from Seagate
stages.whoB: The inmate who coached him and died for it

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Squabbles sits in Reva's group sessions, where he says Reggie had a life but in here he is Squabbles. Reva begs him to tell her about Carl, but he keeps his friend's secrets.
stages.whoA: The counselor who runs his group
stages.whoB: An inmate in her group

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Rackham's men frame Squabbles to force Carl into the fights. When Carl plans to expose the ring, Shades and Comanche beat Squabbles until he talks, and he dies.
stages.whoA: One of the inmates who beat him to death
stages.whoB: The inmate he beats for Rackham

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Squabbles stops Carl from beating Comanche to death. Later Comanche and Shades beat Squabbles in his cell until he dies.
stages.whoA: Comanche, who helps kill him
stages.whoB: The inmate who once saved him from Carl

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Mariah hires Stephanie as a hostess, renames her Billie, and uses her to seduce Mark Higgins for blackmail. At Gwen's, Mariah realizes Billie has been spying for Bushmaster and has her shot.
stages.whoA: The boss she spies on, who kills her
stages.whoB: The hostess who betrayed her

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Stephanie feeds Bushmaster's crew what she learns at Harlem's Paradise, including word about Piranha. When Bushmaster takes the club, she greets him with a kiss on the cheek.
stages.whoA: The man she spies for
stages.whoB: A spy inside Mariah's club

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Luke breaks up Zip's shakedown of Genghis Connie's, and one of Zip's crew runs rather than fight him, saying he doesn't even like the others.
stages.whoA: The hero he won't fight
stages.whoB: A Stokes thug who runs from him

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Sugar feeds Luke tips while driving for Mariah, then walks out on her and tells Luke Harlem needs a king. Luke makes him his right hand at Harlem's Paradise.
stages.whoA: The hero he ends up working for
stages.whoB: His informant and right hand

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: One of Cottonmouth's enforcers sits splattered with Koko's blood when Cottonmouth shoots Koko, then is sent out to collect the Luke Cage stupidity tax.
stages.whoA: The boss who gave him a job
stages.whoB: One of his street enforcers

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Sugar follows Mariah around the park as Cottonmouth's bodyguard and stays on when she takes over.
stages.whoA: The councilwoman he guards
stages.whoB: Cottonmouth's muscle, now hers

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Sugar drives Mariah and lends her his wife's clothes after her home burns, but quits when she marches Anansi to Gwen's. Mariah spares him when she cleans house.
stages.whoA: The boss he finally walks out on
stages.whoB: The driver she spares

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: After Cottonmouth's death, Shades tells Sugar and Zip they work for him now, and keeps him on through Diamondback's siege of Harlem's Paradise.
stages.whoA: The enforcer who takes charge of him
stages.whoB: One of his crew

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Shades posts Sugar to guard the back of Harlem's Paradise during the gang war.
stages.whoA: Mariah's right hand
stages.whoB: A guard at the club

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Zip and a fellow enforcer guard Mariah in the park and shake down the Lins together. Luke knocks Zip down while his partner flees.
stages.whoA: His partner in Cottonmouth's crew
stages.whoB: A fellow enforcer

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Misty calls her old squad partner Tomas to cover for her at a Brooklyn warehouse, and he tells her about the Stylers and John McIver. At Gwen's he lets her stay on the scene and checks the casings with her.
stages.whoA: His old partner, now Harlem's favorite detective
stages.whoB: Her old squad partner in Brooklyn

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Tomas meets Luke at the warehouse and recognizes Bushmaster's photo as John McIver. At Gwen's he tells Luke to leave the scene and that police cannot pin it on Mariah yet.
stages.whoA: The hero who keeps showing up at his scenes
stages.whoB: A Brooklyn detective who helps

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Posing as police, Billy and his partner search Steven's flat and find a passport for Marc Spector with Steven's face. They cuff him and drive him to Arthur Harrow instead of a station.
stages.whoA: The man he hands over to Harrow
stages.whoB: A crooked detective in Harrow's cult

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Billy brings Steven to Harrow, then follows him to Egypt as the cult digs for Ammit's tomb. He goes into the tomb for Harrow, and a Heka Priest kills him there.
stages.whoA: The cult leader he serves
stages.whoB: One of his followers, a detective

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Donna manages Steven at the gallery gift shop and scolds him for playing tour guide. She mocks his steak date and threatens to shove him in a sarcophagus when he asks about the Ennead.
stages.whoA: Steven, her clumsy gift shop clerk
stages.whoB: His bossy manager at the gallery

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: J.B. guards the gallery where Steven works and keeps calling him Scotty. He shrugs off Steven's fear of being followed, then lets him watch the footage of the wrecked toilets, which only shows Steven.
stages.whoA: Steven, a gallery coworker he calls Scotty
stages.whoB: The gallery guard who calls him Scotty

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Osiris warns Khonshu to stop drawing attention to the gods and dismisses his charge against Harrow. When Khonshu turns back the sky, the gods seal him in stone.
stages.whoA: The god he locks away for meddling
stages.whoB: The Ennead's leader, who imprisons him

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Osiris questions Harrow at the gods' council and rules that he has done nothing wrong. Later Harrow storms the chamber with his followers and cuts down the gods' avatars.
stages.whoA: The man he cleared, who turns on the gods
stages.whoB: The god who cleared him at the council

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: After Harrow's attack, Osiris asks Layla if she freed Khonshu. He tells her the chamber can bind Ammit in a human body, but they need more avatars.
stages.whoA: The woman he tells how to stop Ammit
stages.whoB: The god who tells her how to bind Ammit

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Yatzil sits on the council Osiris leads, speaking for Hathor at Harrow's hearing. They stand together when Harrow storms the chamber, and Harrow kills her.
stages.whoA: Hathor's avatar on his council
stages.whoB: The god who leads the council

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Wendy blames her son Marc for Randall's drowning and beats him on his birthday. Marc leaves home, and when she dies he refuses to go to her shiva.
stages.whoA: Her son, whom she blames for Randall
stages.whoB: His mother, who blamed and beat him

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Randall is Wendy's younger son, who drowns in a cave while playing with Marc. Wendy never stops grieving him and blames Marc.
stages.whoA: Her younger son, who drowns
stages.whoB: His mother

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Yatzil greets Marc as Khonshu's avatar at the gods' council. After Harrow is cleared, she tells Marc that Senfu's sarcophagus will lead him to Ammit's tomb.
stages.whoA: Khonshu's avatar, whom she helps
stages.whoB: Hathor's avatar, who points him to Senfu

stages.title: Moon Knight
stages.text: Yatzil sits in judgment as Harrow wins over the gods' council. When he returns to free Ammit, she stands against him with the other avatars, and he kills her.
stages.whoA: The man who kills her
stages.whoB: Hathor's avatar, whom he kills

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Aadam welcomes Kamala into his house as the Clandestines tell their story. When she backs out, he attacks her with his mace at Aamir's wedding and later chases her through Karachi.
stages.whoA: The girl with the bangle he hunts
stages.whoB: A Clandestine who attacks her with a mace

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Aadam hunts Kareem and Kamala across Karachi and throws Kareem down in an alley. Kareem slips behind him and stabs him dead.
stages.whoA: The Red Dagger who kills him
stages.whoB: The Clandestine he kills in an alley

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Aadam follows Najma in the hunt for the bangle, from India in 1942 to Aamir's wedding. After they break out of Damage Control, he goes with her to Karachi.
stages.whoA: The Clandestines' leader
stages.whoB: One of her Clandestines

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Aadam teases Kamran about his crush on Kamala when she visits. Kamran turns on the Clandestines at the wedding, but helps them break out, and Najma leaves him behind.
stages.whoA: Najma's son, whom he teases
stages.whoB: A Clandestine who teases him about Kamala

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Aadam and Fariha search for the bangle together in 1942 and fight Kamala at Aamir's wedding. In Karachi they chase her in a stolen truck.
stages.whoA: A fellow Clandestine
stages.whoB: A fellow Clandestine

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Barrie works under Deever in the hunt for Kamran, setting up patrols and the siege at Coles Academic. When Cleary relieves her, Barrie hands her the phone and pulls the agents out.
stages.whoA: His commander at Damage Control
stages.whoB: An agent under her command

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Barrie fires on Kamala as she shields Kamran outside Coles Academic, and she smashes the cannon beside him. He chases her, but the crowd blocks him and she gets away.
stages.whoA: The hero who blocks his bullets
stages.whoB: A Damage Control agent who fires on her

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Barrie fires on Kamran when he refuses to surrender outside Coles Academic. Kamran's blast of power knocks Barrie to the ground.
stages.whoA: The boy he is sent to take alive
stages.whoB: An agent who shoots at him

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Fariha fights Kamala with her spear at Aamir's wedding and again in Karachi. When the veil opens, she runs past Kamala toward home and dies.
stages.whoA: The girl with the bangle she hunts
stages.whoB: A Clandestine who fights her with a spear

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Fariha follows Najma from the bangle hunt in 1942 to the attack on Kamala's family wedding. She breaks out with Najma and is the first to run for the opened veil.
stages.whoA: The Clandestines' leader
stages.whoB: One of her Clandestines

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: In 1942 Fariha hunts for the bangle with Aisha and the other Clandestines in India. British soldiers break them up, and Aisha escapes with the bangle.
stages.whoA: A fellow Clandestine, lost in 1942
stages.whoB: A fellow Clandestine

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Mr. Wilson calls Kamala down over the intercom and talks to her about her future. He tells her to stop daydreaming and plan for college.
stages.whoA: A student he counsels
stages.whoB: Her school guidance counselor

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Mr. Wilson calls Bruno to his office with big news. He tells him he has a free place in Caltech's Early Immersion program.
stages.whoA: A student he sends to Caltech
stages.whoB: His school guidance counselor

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Kamala climbs the mosque to save Hameed when he dangles from the minaret, and asks him his favorite food to keep him calm. Her platforms break his fall, and later he praises Ms. Marvel online.
stages.whoA: The masked girl who saves him
stages.whoB: The boy she saves from the minaret

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Najaf trades news with Kamala from his food truck while she runs errands. Later he joins the crowd shielding Ms. Marvel, and boasts she loves his gyros.
stages.whoA: A regular at his food truck
stages.whoB: The food truck owner she chats with

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Nakia asks for Najaf's vote for the mosque board at the Eid party. He agrees if she makes him the only caterer for mosque events, and puts up her poster.
stages.whoA: The candidate who gets his vote
stages.whoB: A voter she wins over with a deal

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Owais greets his cousin Kamala in Karachi and teases her about her height. He tours the city with her and Zainab, then leaves her to see the train station.
stages.whoA: His cousin from America
stages.whoB: Her cousin in Karachi

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Owais welcomes his aunt Muneeba to Karachi. When Kamala does not come home, he shows Muneeba how to find her phone.
stages.whoA: Kamala's mother
stages.whoB: Kamala's cousin in Karachi

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Owais and his sister Zainab meet Kamala in Karachi and take her out to lunch and around the market. They go off together when she heads for the train station.
stages.whoA: His sister
stages.whoB: Her brother

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Rasheed is Yusuf's best friend, and is stung to see Yusuf holding Nakia's flyer. Later he sends Yusuf a video of the fight at Kamala's school.
stages.whoA: His best friend
stages.whoB: His best friend from the mosque

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Rasheed runs against Nakia for the mosque board. Yusuf hesitates to back Nakia because Rasheed is his best friend, and Rasheed is stung to see him holding her flyer.
stages.whoA: His rival for the mosque board
stages.whoB: Her rival for the mosque board

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: When Damage Control comes for Kamran at the mosque, Rasheed and Sheikh Abdullah stall the agents. Rasheed offers them his famous cookies while Abdullah stands firm.
stages.whoA: The imam he helps stall the agents
stages.whoB: A friend who stalls the agents with him

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Ruby and Muneeba trade gossip about Fatima's broken engagement as Muneeba shops for the wedding. Muneeba names Ruby as one of the people who made her feel at home, and Ruby celebrates Aamir's wedding with the family.
stages.whoA: Her friend, Kamala's mother
stages.whoB: Her gossiping friend

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Ruby tells Kamala her dress is wrong and gossips that Aisha killed a man. At Aamir's wedding she dances with Kamala, and later shields Ms. Marvel from Damage Control.
stages.whoA: Muneeba's daughter, the hero she shields
stages.whoB: A family friend

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Ruby joins the crowd around Ms. Marvel outside Coles Academic. She plants herself in front of Barrie and tells him the hero saved their lives.
stages.whoA: The agent she stands up to
stages.whoB: A bystander who blocks him

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Saleem lashes at Kamala with his whip at Aamir's wedding and corners her before Damage Control arrives. He chases her through Karachi until he is killed.
stages.whoA: The girl with the bangle he hunts
stages.whoB: A Clandestine who fights her with a whip

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Saleem points out that Kamran is only 17 when Kamala visits. After the breakout he helps the hurt Kamran, but leaves him behind on Najma's order with an apology.
stages.whoA: Najma's son, whom he leaves behind
stages.whoB: A Clandestine who says sorry as he leaves

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Saleem follows Najma from the bangle hunt in 1942 to the wedding attack. When she orders them to abandon Kamran, he obeys, and dies in her attack on the Red Daggers.
stages.whoA: The Clandestines' leader
stages.whoB: One of her Clandestines

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Saleem joins the raid on the Red Daggers' hideout in Karachi. Waleed kills him with two daggers to the chest.
stages.whoA: The Red Dagger who kills him
stages.whoB: A Clandestine he kills

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Zainab greets her cousin Kamala in Karachi and shows her the city with an app. She heads off for coffee with friends when Kamala wants to see the train station.
stages.whoA: Her cousin from America
stages.whoB: Her cousin in Karachi

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Zainab welcomes her aunt Muneeba to Karachi. She is there when Muneeba learns Kamala has gone missing.
stages.whoA: Kamala's mother
stages.whoB: Kamala's cousin in Karachi

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Peter buys his usual sandwich from Delmar, who teases him about May and tells him to stay in school. When a robber's blast cuts the deli in half, Spider-Man pulls Delmar and Murph out.
stages.whoA: A regular who saves him as Spider-Man
stages.whoB: The deli owner who makes his sandwiches

stages.title: Peter's To-Do List
stages.text: Before his class trip, Peter stops at Delmar's new deli for a headphone adapter and tries his Spanish. Delmar asks if he can come to Europe too.
stages.whoA: A regular off to Europe
stages.whoB: The deli owner who asks to come along

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: G'iah welcomes Beto to New Skrullos and feeds him Skrull food. Later she leaves him waiting in the car during Brogan's rescue, and he calls her a smart lady.
stages.whoA: The rebel who welcomes him
stages.whoB: A newcomer she brings into the rebels

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Pagon readies Beto for the Royal Navy mission and tells him all faith is built on risk. When Gravik kills Pagon, Beto leads a revolt to avenge him.
stages.whoA: The commander he avenges
stages.whoB: An operative he leads on missions

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Beto joins Gravik's rebels and serves on his missions. After Gravik kills Pagon, Beto leads a revolt, calls him a monster, and Gravik kills him.
stages.whoA: His leader, who kills him
stages.whoB: A soldier who turns on him

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Beto and Zirksu infiltrate the Royal Navy together under Pagon. They join the revolt against Gravik, and both die in the fight.
stages.whoA: A fellow operative and rebel
stages.whoB: A fellow operative and rebel

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Pagon oversees Brogan taking an American's face. He breaks Brogan out of the torture site, then shoots him in the woods.
stages.whoA: The commander who rescues, then kills him
stages.whoB: An operative he rescues, then kills

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Brogan carries a decoy bag in Gravik's Moscow bombing. Gravik rescues him from Falsworth, suspects he talked and has him killed.
stages.whoA: His leader, who has him killed
stages.whoB: An operative he suspects of talking

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: G'iah hands Brogan the empty decoy bag for the Moscow attack. She drives the car when the rebels rescue him and he is killed.
stages.whoA: The rebel who hands him the decoy bag
stages.whoB: A courier in the Moscow attack

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Falsworth takes over Brogan's interrogation, cuts off a finger to prove he is a Skrull and heats his blood. He tells her about Gravik's machine and the Daltons.
stages.whoA: The MI6 agent who tortures him
stages.whoB: A Skrull she tortures for names

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Pagon sends Zirksu to drive G'iah to the bomb deal in Moscow.
stages.whoA: The rebel he drives to the bomb deal
stages.whoB: Her driver to the bomb deal

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Pagon assigns Zirksu to drive G'iah, then leads him and Beto into the Royal Navy. After Gravik kills Pagon, Zirksu joins the revolt.
stages.whoA: The commander he follows
stages.whoB: An operative he leads

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Zirksu cheers Gravik's return and serves on his missions. In the revolt he tries to stab Gravik, who turns the knife on him.
stages.whoA: His leader, who kills him
stages.whoB: An operative who turns on him

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: The anchor stands with Gravik when the Council makes him Skrull General. Gravik later shows him the Super Skrull plan.
stages.whoA: The general he backs on the Council
stages.whoB: A Council member who backs him

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Stearns and Lawton sit on the Skrull Council together. Both stand with Gravik and hear his Super Skrull plan.
stages.whoA: A fellow Council member
stages.whoB: A fellow Council member

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Falsworth briefs her MI6 boss on the Skrulls and talks him out of a raid. Later she shoots him, shows his staff he is a Skrull and makes him talk.
stages.whoA: The agent who exposes him
stages.whoB: Her MI6 boss, a Skrull mole

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Colonel Rhodes reports Fury AWOL, greets Ritson in England and pushes him to strike Russia. In the hospital, Fury proves Rhodes is a Skrull and kills him.
stages.whoA: His envoy Rhodes, secretly a Skrull
stages.whoB: The President he steers toward war

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Fury pulls Ritson from his wrecked car and later stops him striking Russia. When Ritson declares war on aliens, Fury scolds him and Ritson tells him to get the Skrulls off Earth.
stages.whoA: The spy who saves him, then scolds him
stages.whoB: The President he saves and argues with

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Falsworth holds Rhodes at gunpoint in front of Ritson and asks what he has to lose by waiting. Ritson calls off the strike.
stages.whoA: The MI6 agent who backs Fury
stages.whoB: The President she talks round

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Lawton nominates Gravik as Skrull General and leads the Council to submit to him. He then shows the Council his Super Skrull plan.
stages.whoA: The general she puts in charge
stages.whoB: The Council member who makes him general

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: At a London summit, Lawton demands to know why Colonel Rhodes came instead of President Ritson. Rhodes dismisses the Russian photos of Fury and Hill.
stages.whoA: The U.S. envoy she grills
stages.whoB: The prime minister who grills him

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: The Daltons build and test Gravik's Super Skrull machine together. When Falsworth raids their lab, Victor takes Rosa hostage and is shot.
stages.whoA: Her partner, who takes her hostage
stages.whoB: His partner, whom he takes hostage

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Falsworth raids Dr. Dalton's lab, makes her explain her research and burns the place. She shoots Victor when he takes Rosa hostage.
stages.whoA: The MI6 agent who raids her lab
stages.whoB: A Skrull scientist she captures

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Pagon tells Dr. Dalton the Harvest was not found and hints Gravik is not always right. She tells him to leave.
stages.whoA: The rebel who brings bad news
stages.whoB: The scientist who sends him away

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Victor pulls a gun on Falsworth in his lab, then takes Rosa hostage outside. Falsworth shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: The MI6 agent who kills him
stages.whoB: A Skrull scientist she shoots

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Pagon visits the Daltons' lab to report the Harvest is missing, before they test their machine.
stages.whoA: The rebel who reports to the lab
stages.whoB: A scientist at the Daltons' lab

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Sergio trades insults with Gravik at the Council and calls the vote for him treason. A guard silences him, he submits, and Gravik shows him the Super Skrull plan.
stages.whoA: The general he gives in to
stages.whoB: A Council member who gives in

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Sergio calls Lawton a traitor for nominating Gravik. She tells him to sit down, and a guard chops his throat.
stages.whoA: The Council member he calls a traitor
stages.whoB: The Council member she silences

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Shirley calls Talos after the Council vote and offers to help. She warns Gravik will kill him, but agrees to set up a meeting.
stages.whoA: The old friend she helps
stages.whoB: A Council elder who helps him

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Shirley chairs the Council meeting to judge Gravik for Moscow. She refuses to submit to his coup, and he lets her leave in peace.
stages.whoA: The rebel she will not follow
stages.whoB: The elder who defies him

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Lawton nominates Gravik while Shirley is chairing the meeting. Shirley refuses to submit and walks out.
stages.whoA: The member who backs Gravik
stages.whoB: The elder who walks out

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Fury catches Poprishchin in two lies about his wife and the dirty bombs. When Poprishchin overpowers Talos, Fury shoots him.
stages.whoA: The spy who shoots him
stages.whoB: The bomb maker he shoots

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Poprishchin unmasks the agent called Keller as Talos and calls him a traitor to his people. The two Skrulls fight in the gallery.
stages.whoA: The Skrull he calls a traitor
stages.whoB: The Skrull he fights for the bombs

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Fury holds Zachary at gunpoint so the Skrull posing as his father lets Talos go. Then he lets Zachary hug his dad.
stages.whoA: The intruder who holds him at gunpoint
stages.whoB: The boy he uses as leverage

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Talos offers Zachary water to calm him. Zachary asks if Talos will kill his dad, and Talos says his dad just has to do the right thing.
stages.whoA: The intruder who tries to calm him
stages.whoB: The boy he tries to calm

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Klev livestreams Shaun's fight against the men who attack him on a San Francisco bus. He cheers Shaun on and grades the fight for his viewers as it goes.
stages.whoA: The bus passenger whose fight he livestreams
stages.whoB: The vlogger who livestreams his bus fight

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Klev and Katy are on the bus when Shaun is attacked. With the driver knocked out, Klev refuses to drive, and Katy takes the wheel.
stages.whoA: The passenger who drives the bus he will not
stages.whoB: The vlogger who refuses to drive the bus

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Klev cheers for Shaun until a man with a blade for an arm joins the attack on the bus, then takes it back. The attacker slices the bus apart as Klev keeps filming.
stages.whoA: The bladed attacker who wrecks his bus
stages.whoB: A vlogger filming on the bus he wrecks

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Soo and Katy are old friends who once went joyriding in a stolen Mustang. Over dinner Soo urges Katy to use her Berkeley degree, then watches Wong lead Katy away through a portal.
stages.whoA: Her old friend, a valet with a Berkeley degree
stages.whoB: Her old friend, now a lawyer

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Soo tells Shaun he is wasting his talents parking cars. Two weeks later she mocks his story of saving the world, until Wong calls for Shang-Chi and takes him through a portal.
stages.whoA: Her old friend Shaun, who speaks four languages
stages.whoB: An old friend who says he is wasting his talents

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Ched blurts out Jen's firing at a family dinner and later barges into her apartment with She-Hulk goods to sign. When Jen says Titania owns the name, he lectures her on trademarks. He also DJs Lulu's wedding and joins the family barbecue.
stages.whoA: His cousin Jen, a lawyer who is also She-Hulk
stages.whoB: Her cousin, a Best Buy manager

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Ched excitedly greets Bruce when he turns up at the family barbecue, back from Sakaar. When Bruce introduces his son Skaar, Ched asks about the space thing.
stages.whoA: His cousin Bruce, back from Sakaar
stages.whoB: A cousin at the family barbecue

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Morris tells the family not to bring up Jen's firing, but Ched blurts it out, saying he thought Morris wanted it mentioned. Both are at the family barbecue too.
stages.whoA: Jen's dad, who hosts the family meals
stages.whoB: A relative who blurts out Jen's firing

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Rebecca yells at Ched when he blurts out Jen's firing at the family dinner. Both later sit down to the family barbecue with Matt Murdock.
stages.whoA: A relative who scolds him at dinner
stages.whoB: A relative who blurts out Jen's firing

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Ched DJs Lulu's wedding as DJ In-ch-ch-chedible Hulk, hyping her guests at the reception.
stages.whoA: The bride whose wedding he DJs
stages.whoB: The DJ at her wedding

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Chuck calls Jen on a Sunday after Blonsky's inhibitor sends a malfunction alert and asks her to meet him at the retreat as backup. He urges her to hulk out, then leaves once the device is fixed.
stages.whoA: Blonsky's lawyer, his backup at the retreat
stages.whoB: Blonsky's parole officer

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Chuck checks on Blonsky at his retreat after an inhibitor alert, fearing he will find the Abomination. Blonsky blames a jolt from an electric fence, and Chuck recalibrates the inhibitor.
stages.whoA: The parolee he supervises
stages.whoB: His parole officer

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Cornelius echoes Donny's every word when Wong and Jen serve a cease and desist, and backs him in court. When Donny's act lets demons loose, Donny apologizes to him, and Cornelius agrees to the cease and desist.
stages.whoA: The magician he hype-mans
stages.whoB: His hype man at the Mystic Castle

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Cornelius sides with Donny against Wong's cease and desist and in court. When demons overrun the magic show, Wong and Jen fight them off and Cornelius gives in.
stages.whoA: The sorcerer suing Donny
stages.whoB: Donny's hype man

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Jen asks Cornelius if he is just hype-manning Donny when he echoes him. During the demon attack she holds a demon over the pair until Cornelius agrees to the cease and desist.
stages.whoA: Wong's lawyer, who serves the cease and desist
stages.whoB: Donny's echoing hype man

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Dennis tries to take over Jen's closing at the DA's office and needles She-Hulk at the bar. When he sues the woman who posed as Megan Thee Stallion, Jen testifies he is deluded enough to believe it, and he wins. Later he tells television that he dated her and she was psycho.
stages.whoA: A former coworker who testifies he is deluded
stages.whoB: A smug former coworker at the DA's office

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Bukowski brings his suit against the shapeshifter who posed as Megan Thee Stallion to GLK&H and picks Pug as his lawyer. Pug calls Jen as a witness and wins him $175,000.
stages.whoA: His lawyer at GLK&H
stages.whoB: A client from the DA's office

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Runa posed as Megan Thee Stallion and took Bukowski for $175,000 before revealing herself. He sues her, and she loses and is jailed for impersonating a judge.
stages.whoA: The shapeshifter who scammed him
stages.whoB: The mark she scammed as Megan Thee Stallion

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Nikki jokes that she will kill Dennis when he tries to take Jen's closing, and later tells him to take a lap at the bar. She calls him gross before Jen testifies in his case.
stages.whoA: A paralegal who cannot stand him
stages.whoB: A coworker she cannot stand

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Wong sues Donny for using the Mystic Arts in his shows after he was kicked out of Kamar-Taj. Donny mocks him and wins a ruling to keep performing. When demons pour through, Donny begs Wong for help and agrees to stop.
stages.whoA: The sorcerer who sues him
stages.whoB: A Kamar-Taj dropout misusing magic

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Jen serves Donny with Wong's cease and desist, and he mocks her dating app. During the demon attack she holds a demon over him until he agrees to sign.
stages.whoA: Wong's lawyer
stages.whoB: The magician she serves with papers

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Donny sends Madisynn through a portal during his show into a realm full of demons. She later testifies about it in Wong's case against him.
stages.whoA: A volunteer he sent through a portal
stages.whoB: The magician who sent her through a portal

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Josh charms Jen at Lulu's wedding and they share fries after her fight with Titania. After a few dates he draws her blood as she sleeps, copies her phone and ghosts her. A recording of their night is later shown at her awards gala.
stages.whoA: The woman he seduced to steal her blood
stages.whoB: A charming date who ghosts her

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: After taking Jen's blood, Josh texts HulkKing that the job is done. Todd later admits he hired Josh to seduce Jen and steal her blood.
stages.whoA: HulkKing, who hired him
stages.whoB: The man he hired to seduce Jen

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Josh is a guest of the groom at Lulu's wedding. Lulu pulls Jen away from him to help her clean up inside.
stages.whoA: The bride at the wedding he attends
stages.whoB: A guest of the groom

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Jen breaks out of her show and confronts K.E.V.I.N., who says he makes every decision. She argues her ending is a mess, and he agrees to her changes. He then locks her out and jokes about seeing her on the big screen.
stages.whoA: The hero who rewrites his ending
stages.whoB: The AI who makes the decisions

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Lulu, Jen's old high school friend, makes her a bridesmaid and makes her promise not to be She-Hulk at the wedding. She dismisses Jen's fears about Titania and puts her to work. After the fight, a tipsy Lulu hugs She-Hulk.
stages.whoA: Her high school friend and bridesmaid
stages.whoB: Her high school friend, the bride

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Titania turns up at Lulu's wedding as a guest. Lulu welcomes her and tells Jen she sounds insane for thinking Titania came to cause trouble.
stages.whoA: A celebrity guest at her wedding
stages.whoB: The bride at the wedding she crashes

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: At a family dinner, Melanie offers to give Jen chunky highlights like She-Hulk's hair. At the barbecue she sits by Jen and Matt.
stages.whoA: Jen, whose hair she offers to restyle
stages.whoB: A stylist at the family dinners

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: At the Walters family barbecue, Melanie eyes Matt and asks why he does not stay longer. She is pulled away to help with the hamburgers.
stages.whoA: Jen's date at the barbecue
stages.whoB: A guest who flirts with him

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Price rejects Runa's claim of diplomatic immunity, saying Thor's speeches are not admissible. After Runa poses as him to drop the case, he jails her for 60 days.
stages.whoA: The shapeshifter who impersonates him
stages.whoB: The judge she impersonates

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Price presides as Jen gives her closing when Titania crashes in. He rules on Bukowski's case after her testimony, and later sides with Matt against her in the Patilio suit.
stages.whoA: A lawyer who appears in his court
stages.whoB: A judge who hears her cases

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Matt arrives late to Price's court to defend Luke Jacobson. Price agrees the client list stays private, and dismisses the case once Matt shows the plaintiff used jet fuel.
stages.whoA: A lawyer who wins in his court
stages.whoB: The judge who rules his way

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Rebecca is at the family dinner after Jen is fired and scolds Ched for bringing it up. At the barbecue Jen tells her not to ask Matt how much money he makes.
stages.whoA: Her niece Jen
stages.whoB: Her Aunt Rebecca

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: At the barbecue, Rebecca quizzes Matt about his Hell's Kitchen practice. When he says he takes cases that do not pay, she concludes he does not make much money.
stages.whoA: Jen's date, a Hell's Kitchen lawyer
stages.whoB: Jen's aunt, who grills him

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Morris tells the family not to mention Jen's firing before Ched blurts it out. At the barbecue he points out to Rebecca that Matt has his own practice.
stages.whoA: A relative who hosts the family meals
stages.whoB: A relative at the family meals

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Jen testifies in Bukowski's suit that he is deluded enough to have believed Runa was Megan Thee Stallion. Her testimony wins the case, and Runa is jailed.
stages.whoA: The witness who sinks her case
stages.whoB: The scammer in Bukowski's case

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Pug represents Bukowski in his suit against Runa and sees through her when she poses as the judge. He wins full damages for his client.
stages.whoA: The lawyer suing her
stages.whoB: The defendant he beats in court

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Thunderball and his crew jump Jen with stolen Asgardian tools, and he tries to take her blood with a needle. It bends on her skin, and the crew flees.
stages.whoA: The Hulk whose blood he fails to take
stages.whoB: A thug who tries to take her blood

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Thunderball fails to get She-Hulk's blood, and his crew leader says their boss is going to be mad. He later sits at the Intelligencia gathering where Todd turns out to be its founder, HulkKing.
stages.whoA: HulkKing, the head of Intelligencia
stages.whoB: A member at his Intelligencia gathering

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Guterman writes the fake story of Quentin Beck, a soldier from another Earth, and Beck toasts him for it. In London, Guterman delivers Peter's classmates into the kill zone on Beck's orders, and Beck praises his work.
stages.whoA: His boss, whose fake hero story he writes
stages.whoB: The crew writer who invents his backstory

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Guterman helps Beck's crew fool the world while Peter believes Mysterio is a hero. Once Peter learns the truth, Guterman puts Peter's friends on Tower Bridge, right in the path of Beck's drones.
stages.whoA: The teen hero Beck's crew sets out to stop
stages.whoB: Beck's writer, who puts his friends in danger

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Guterman and Janice both work on Beck's crew and are toasted side by side at its celebration. During the London attack, each reports in when Beck checks on his team.
stages.whoA: A fellow member of Beck's crew
stages.whoB: A fellow member of Beck's crew

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
